title: People Business Partner
description:
Job: People Business Partner
Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue, one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won: the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue, and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

As a People Business Partner (PBP), you are the strategic people advisor to the leaders in your respective business units. You own the outcomes in partnership with your key stakeholders: the people strategy, the risk, and the quality of every program that touches your teams, your time goes to advising, calibrating, and solving. You'll regularly partner with Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Benefits, and Legal.

  • Drive engagement. Review engagement results with leaders at every level, align on action plans, and make sure they get done, including working directly with front-line managers.
  • Own employee relations. Oversee complex employee relations matt

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

About This Role

ClickUp is looking for a Senior Database Reliability Engineer to join our Database Operations team. You’ll be responsible for the performance, integrity, security, and availability of our PostgreSQL databases running on Linux in AWS. This role focuses on day-to-day database administration, operational excellence, and ensuring data is consistently reliable and well-managed across environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer, monitor, and maintain PostgreSQL databases (250GB+) in production environments (AWS RDS, Aurora, EC2)

  • Ensure database availability, performance, and data integrity through proactive monitoring and maintenance

  • Perform routine database administration tasks including patching, upgrades, vacuuming, reindexing, and statistics management

  • Execute and manage backup, restore, and disaster recovery procedures, including regular testing of recovery plans

  • Handle user access management, roles, and database security to ensure compliance with best practices

  • Perform capacity planning, storage management, and growth forecasting

  • Troubleshoot database issues, including performance bottlenecks, locking/contention, and failed jobs

  • Support application teams with query tuning, schema changes, and release deployments

  • Manage database migrations, upgrades, and change requests with minimal downtime

  • Maintain documentation for database configurations, standards, and operational procedures

  • Participate in on-call rotations and provide support for production incidents

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in a senior database administrator or Database Engineering role

  • Strong hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience, including backups, recovery, and performance tuning

  • Solid understanding of database security, access control, and compliance practices

  • Experience managing large-scale production databases (250GB+), including maintenance and lifecycle management

  • Strong Linux administration skills (processes, disk, memory, networking)

  • Experience with monitoring tools and performance diagnostics

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, or similar)

  • Familiarity with cloud-based database deployme

title: Director, Technology Alliances
description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. This is where Apollo puts the large majority of its focus and resources once an integration has proven it's worth building a genuine alliance around.

As Apollo's technology alliance ecosystem and revenue contribution scale, you'll hire and lead a team of Technology Partner Managers to carry that portfolio forward.

title: Generative Media Engineer, AI Social - US
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

AI Social is one of the most ambitious products we've ever shipped. An AI agent that produces on-brand Instagram carousels and reels for every Luxury Presence customer, from raw input data to finished media. It isn't LLMs writing code. It's LLMs designing, choosing the photo, voicing the script, picking the cuts, and composing the final frame.

As the Generative Media Engineer on AI Social, you own the render pipeline, the prompts and agent loops that drive it, and the visual quality of what ships. Product and content strategy partners set the direction; engineering and design peers ship alongside you. This is an unusual role at the intersection of code, design, AI, and social media. You don't fit the normal engineering mold, that's the point.

Skills and experience

  • Solid working knowledge of TypeScript and Node.js. You're comfortable shipping production code and you're ready to grow into our stack.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-driven systems. Prompts, structured outputs, tool-calling, agent loops, evals.
  • At least one shipped piece of generative media in image, video, voice, or music that someone other than you has seen and used.
  • A portfolio or body of work that demonstrates both technical depth and design sensibility.
  • Bonus: a personal creator practice somewhere. A feed, a portfolio, a side project, a YouTube channel, an Are.na. Public, ongoing, under your own name. You understand the medium because you've lived in it.
  • Formal or self-taught grounding in design, visual art, film, or motion.
  • Comfort moving between exploratory PoC work and shipped-to-customers polish, with judgment about which mode is appropriate when.

Technical fluency with AI tools

  • You're already using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted development tools in your daily workflow. We're a Claude Code shop and we expect you to be fluent.
  • Familiarity with MCPs and how tools like Figma, Notion, and Linear connect into AI-assisted workflows. You understand how these tools and integrations fit together and can help the team get more out of them.
  • Beyond fluency, you're a dabbler and experimenter. You try new prompts, push their limits, and share what you learn. You have opinions about where the medium is headed.

title: Engineering Manager, Maps & Search - US
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We don't just use AI. We build with it, ship with it, and think with it. With a generous budget for tokens, our engineers use AI agents to write, review, and ship production code every day. We are building toward a world where humans design systems and AI builds them, and we are already far along that path.

We are hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead Maps & Search. This team owns the home search experience across web and mobile. It's one of the most visible, highest-traffic surfaces–the search service alone handles a billion requests every month.

This is a role for a manager who leads from the front: someone who still lives in their terminal with AI, has strong opinions about how AI changes the SDLC, and wants to amplify what a small, senior, AI-augmented team can accomplish. You will set technical direction, stay close to the code, and help the team produce consistent impact.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow the Maps & Search team. Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development. Treat management as a craft and build a healthy, high-performing team that ships impactful changes.

Stay hands-on. Contribute directly — code and design reviews, architecture, thorny debugging— and stay technical enough to make smart calls on trade-offs.

Own and scale a high-throughput search platform. Drive the architecture, relevance, latency, and reliability of a real estate search system handling ~1B monthly requests and hundreds of millions of listings.

Deliver a world-class home search experience. Own the core home discovery experience across web and mobile — improving engagement, lead conversion, and agent workflows while keeping interactions fast and responsive at scale.

Push forward AI-powered discovery. Partner across teams to bring LLMs and intelligent ranking into search and user workflows, improving how buyers and agents discover, filter, and engage with listings.

Shape the roadmap with product and design. Define what we build and why, not just focusing on the how. Translate user needs and business goals into a clear technical plan, and own delivery end to end — planning, quality, reliability, and incident response.

By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help us build and ship AI-powered features that directly improve our product experience and business outcomes. This is a hands-on, product-focused role where you'll take ideas from concept to production — designing intelligent systems, validating them with real users, and turning them into reliable, scalable services.

You'll work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering — partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact opportunities, prototype quickly, and iterate based on data. We're a stealth holding company acquiring and operating software businesses in overlooked, mission-critical industries - the systems that run the physical economy but have been ignored by Silicon Valley. We're rebuilding them as AI-native from the inside out.

We're small, well-capitalized, and moving fast. This is not a research lab. This is a build shop with real customers, real revenue, and real P&Ls.

The Role

You will be the AI engineer. You'll own:

  1. Building the industry-specific GPT: the reasoning layer that encodes the domain expertise of each vertical we operate in.

  2. Embedding AI-native functionality directly into our AI-native system of record: not bolt-on chatbots. Core workflow replacement. Agents that do the job.

  3. Moving legacy systems of record datasets into new ai-native ones: Core workflow replacement. Agents that do the job.

  4. Making it repeatable: Every new company we bring into the portfolio should benefit from the playbook, model stack, eval harness, and infra you build.

  5. Managing AI talent across our operating companies: you'll be a player-coach for the AI engineers embedded at each sub.

Split: 90% building. 10% managing. If that ratio scares you, this isn't your role. If it excites you, keep reading.

What You'll Do…

  • Ship a working domain-specific agent into a live customer environment in your first 30 days

  • Build the eval infrastructure that lets us measure whether these agents are actually replacing human workflows (not vibes)

  • Fine-tune, distill, or route across frontier + open models depending on the economics of each vertical

  • Sit with customers. Watch them work. Instrument their workflows. Rebuild them.

  • Write the AI engineering playbook that every future portfolio company inherits on day one

Who You Are…

  • You are a builder first. You've shipped things people actually use. Alone or as the clear technical lead.

  • You are a forward-deployed engineer. You'll fly to a customer site, sit in their office, and understand the business before you write a line of code.

  • You've been called a 10x engineer and it wasn't in a self-review.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring the next generation of product managers. AI has collapsed the work that used to sit between an idea and a working version of it, and for the first time, PMs can be true builders. The PMs who win in this era do not manage the work. They build the product, every day, with their own hands.

A Senior Product Manager owns a meaningful surface of ClickUp and is accountable for whether it gets better. You decide what to build and why, then go build a working version of it. You prototype in Cursor and Claude when an idea is faster shown than written. You live in the data and the customer signal, and the time between spotting a problem and having something people can react to is measured in days, not weeks. The PMs who compound the most impact at this level are the ones who keep finding leverage that did not exist last quarter.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the vision, roadmap, and delivery for a defined product surface, balancing near-term wins with longer-horizon investments.

  • Run continuous discovery. Building and using agents to monitor and synthesize that part of your job.

  • Write sharp PRDs and specs that give engineering and design what they need to move fast without ambiguity.

  • Define success metrics before you build, track them after you ship, and iterate when outcomes do not match expectations.

  • Prototype your own ideas using Cursor, Claude Code, and our Prototype Playground. Show the concept before filing the ticket.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, analytics, and GTM without needing to be managed through the process.

  • Present your roadmap and results clearly to stakeholders and leadership, and update them when direction changes.

  • Spot friction in how the team operates and suggest concrete improvements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5 or more years in product management with demonstrated end-to-end ownership of a product area in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Proven track record of shipping. You have taken features from concept through launch and iterated based on data.

  • Strong prioritization instincts. You know how to say no and can defend it.

  • High customer empathy and the ability to separate what users say from what they actually need.

  • Comfortable with data.

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We're reinventing how trading and investing work by building exceptional products people love.

We move fast, set a high bar, and expect excellence from everyone on the team.

The role

We're looking for exceptional graduates to join Trading 212 as Graduate Product Managers. You'll help shape products that make investing simpler and more accessible, turning complex problems into intuitive experiences.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one. title: Orbital Analyst
description:
Orbital Analyst

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK and the European Innovation Council.

Position Overview

You’ll be the operationally responsive member of the Astrodynamics team. You’ll take on a wide range of tasks, from producing analysis to demonstrate Foundational’s world leading capabilities, through customer facing discussions with the business development team to supporting customers with operational issues or special requirements. Expect to also be a key point of contact for our ground station teams to help ensure smooth functioning of our tracking network.

title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Brive-la-Gaillarde)
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

Rattaché(e) à la Direction Technique, vous pilotez l'ensemble de la fonction Produit. Vous définissez la stratégie produit, arbitrez les investissements, managez l'équipe et garantissez l'alignement des moyens engagés avec les objectifs de l'entreprise.

title: General Manager
description: Hos Sauna85 skaber vi rum til en pause fra hverdagen. Bag hver saunagus står et hold af mennesker, praktiske opgaver, der skal løses, og små detaljer, der gør oplevelsen bedre.  Vi søger en General Manager, der vil tage ansvar for den daglige drift, koordineringen af vores gusmestre og vores kundeservice. En, der kan skabe overblik, følge ting til dørs og finde løsninger med både driften og gæsten for øje.      Din Rolle   Du bliver et centralt bindeled mellem vores gusmestre, gæster og lokationer. Du får stor selvstændighed i hverdagen og arbejder tæt sammen med Clara og Jonas, som du refererer til og sparrer med.  Dine opgaver omfatter:    Kundeservice:  Besvare henvendelser og håndtere spørgsmål, bookingproblemer og refunderinger.   Drift og vedligehold:  Følge op på lokationernes stand, koordinere vedligehold og selv løse praktiske opgaver.   Administration:  Lønadministration, kontoropgaver og løbende arbejde i vores bookingsystem Ferb og øvrige tekniske systemer.   Vagtplanlægning og koordinering:  Sikre, at vagtplanerne hænger sammen, og at gusmestrene har den information, de skal bruge.   Nye lokationer:  Undersøge muligheder og drive dialog, ansøgninger og opfølgning i forbindelse med nye lokationer.   Saunagus:  Afholde 12 faste gus om måneden som en del af din arbejdstid. Vi sørger for oplæring.   Opgaver undervejs:  Hjælpe med blandt andet events og andre opgaver, der opstår i en virksomhed i udvikling.       Om dig   Du tænker strategisk, arbejder organiseret og er hands-on. Du kan skabe overblik og holde driften kørende, samtidig med at du gerne tager fat – også når glemmekassen skal tømmes, panten skal afleveres, eller personalerummet trænger til at blive ryddet op.  Du har gerne erfaring med kundeservice, bookingsystemer, vagtplanlægning og koordinering af et team. Du er praktisk anlagt og trives med at finde løsninger, når noget ikke fungerer.  Vi forestiller os, at du:   Arbejder selvstændigt og følger opgaver til dørs.  Kan prioritere, når flere ting kræver din opmærksomhed.  Kommunikerer tydeligt og venligt med både gæster og gusmestre.  Har let ved at sætte dig ind i digitale systemer.  Trives med en hverdag, der både foregår ved computeren og ude på lokationerne.  Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk.   Du behøver ikke have erfaring som gusmester. Vi tilbyder uddannelse og oplæring, så du kan blive tryg i rollen.      Hos os får du   Du får stor indflydelse på den daglige drift og mulighed for at være med til at udvikle nye sauna-lokationer. Vi tilbyder gusmesteruddannelse, et stort socialt fællesskab, gratis saunagus og en plads på vores lille, hyggelige kontor i Nordvest.  Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen, primært på hverdage i dagtimerne, med planlagte gus. De 12 månedlige gus er inkluderet i arbejdstiden, som fordeles mellem administration, koordinering og praktiske opgaver.      Søg stillingen   Send dit CV og en kort motivation til  clara@sauna85.dk . Fortæl os kort om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du har lyst til

title: Customer Experience Team Lead (m/w/d)
description: Über Vintage.com     Bei Vintage.com bauen wir die vertrauenswürdigste Plattform für Second-Hand-Artikel auf. Wir helfen Menschen dabei, wertvollen Dingen ein neues Leben zu geben, und machen das Erlebnis einfach, transparent und lohnend.       Wir verbinden Fachwissen, durchdachte Technologie und echte Sorgfalt für unsere Kundschaft. Indem wir mehr Artikel im Umlauf halten, schaffen wir Mehrwert für Menschen und leisten gleichzeitig einen positiven Beitrag.        Über das Team     Unser Customer-Experience-Team betreut Kundschaft in ganz Europa von unseren Standorten in Leeds (Großbritannien), Arnheim (Niederlande) und Korneuburg (Österreich) aus.       Wir sind die menschliche Seite von Vintage.com und begleiten unsere Kundschaft per Telefon, E-Mail und über digitale Kanäle. Das kann bedeuten, jemandem zu erklären, wie unser Service funktioniert, über den Stand der Artikel zu informieren, eine Frage zu beantworten oder die richtige Lösung zu finden, wenn etwas nicht wie geplant gelaufen ist.       Wir arbeiten eng mit Operations, unserem Lager und Teams in ganz Vintage.com zusammen, damit jede Customer Journey so einfach und reibungslos wie möglich ist.        Warum diese Rolle wichtig ist      Warum es diese Rolle gibt     Wie gut wir unsere Kundschaft betreuen, hängt von den Menschen ab, die mit ihr sprechen, und davon, wie gut diese Menschen geführt und unterstützt werden.       Als Customer Experience Team Lead in Korneuburg führst und motivierst du das Team, das Willkommensanrufe, Angebotsanrufe, Rücksendungen und Beschwerden für unsere Kundschaft in Österreich übernimmt. Du bist für die tägliche Leistung, das Wohlbefinden und die Entwicklung deines Teams verantwortlich.       Das ist eine Führungsrolle mit viel Praxisbezug. Du planst Dienstpläne und Arbeitsaufkommen, coachst dein Team, triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Leistungsdaten und übernimmst komplexe Kundensituationen selbst. Du setzt klare Erwartungen, erkennst gute Arbeit an und sprichst Leistungsthemen fair an.       Außerdem gehörst du zu den ersten Führungskräften unseres neuen Teams in Österreich. Du stellst neue Teammitglieder ein, arbeitest sie ein und gestaltest mit, wie das Team arbeitet, während wir wachsen.        Woran wir Erfolg messen      Du erreichst oder übertriffst die vereinbarten Service-Levels, Qualitätsstandards und Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit.    Du löst eskalierte Anrufe beim ersten Kontakt und arbeitest auf das vereinbarte Ziel des Teams hin.    Du baust ein engagiertes Team auf, entwickelst es weiter und bindest es langfristig, gemessen an Mitarbeiterbefragungen und Fluktuation.    Du stellst neue Teammitglieder ein und arbeitest sie so ein, dass sie bis zum Ende ihrer Probezeit sicher am Telefon sind.    Du planst das Arbeitsaufkommen so, dass Anrufe und Rückmeldungen in allen Kanälen abgedeckt sind.    Du etablierst klare Abläufe und Prozesse für das Team in Österreich.        Deine Führungskraft vereinbart konkrete Ziele für diese Kennz

KPI Management and Optimization: Monitor and optimize key call center KPIs, including call connection rate, call answer rate, average handling time (AHT), first contact resolution (FCR), complaint rate, and customer satisfaction (CSAT). Use data analysis to improve service efficiency and quality.  Complaint and Compensation Management: Establish standardized processes for handling customer complaints, compensation claims, and shipment exceptions, ensuring timely resolution and proper follow-up.  Compliance Management: Ensure customer service operations comply with GDPR and applicable local regulations. Maintain appropriate customer data protection practices and business records to ensure traceability.  System Management: Oversee the daily operation of customer service ticketing systems, call center systems, and online customer service platforms, and identify opportunities for system improvements.  Complaint Analysis and Cross-functional Collaboration: Regularly analyze the root causes of customer complaints, prepare complaint analysis reports, and work with sorting centers, line-haul transportation teams, and last-mile delivery stations to implement corrective actions. At least 5 years of customer service experience in the express delivery or logistics industry. Experience in building a customer service team or function from the ground up is preferred. title: Account Manager till Synos Medical!
description: Nu har du möjlighet att ta ditt nästa karriärkliv inom B2B-försäljning och bli en del av Synos Medical i Linköping! Här jobbar du med försäljning av världsledande premiumutrustning i en roll med stora utvecklingsmöjligheter. Välkommen med din ansökan idag!       Om tjänsten   Synos Medical är en ledande leverantör av medicinteknisk utrustning i absolut världsklass till estetiska och medicinska kliniker. Företagets filosofi bygger på ett äkta win-win-koncept: när klinikerna lyckas, lyckas Synos. Därför erbjuder de inte bara marknadens bästa lasermaskiner, utan en helhetslösning med utbildning, affärsutveckling, marknadsföring och livstids rådgivning till kunderna.     Som Account Manager blir du en del av ett tight team på 7 personer med stark gemenskap där dina åsikter och idéer värdesätts högt. Du kliver in i en mycket viktig tillväxtroll där du steg för steg bygger upp din egen kundportfölj och i praktiken driver ditt eget "bolag i bolaget". Din roll som Account Manager innebär ansvar för hela försäljningscykeln - från första kontakt till avslutad affär samt ett långsiktigt relationsbyggande. Du kommer in till en bransch med enorm potential och du kommer arbeta aktivt med att bearbeta nya och befintliga kunder över hela Sverige. För att ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna erbjuder Synos Medical en trygg onboarding och en kontinuerlig, fördjupad säljträning som löper under dina två första år.     För att passa i rollen hos Synos tror vi att du är nyfiken, har en förmåga att jobba ihärdigt och har god affärsmässighet. Du är också kommunikativ och har ett stort resultatfokus. I rollen förekommer även en del resande till kunder runtom i landet.      Arbetsuppgifter   Rollen innebär att driva hela säljprocessen från första kontakt till avslut genom hög aktivitet, relationsbyggande och demonstrationer av Synos lasermaskiner runt om i Sverige. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara att:   Boka och genomföra kundmöten och aktivt arbeta för att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter, både hos nya och befintliga kunder.  Bygga långsiktiga relationer och hjälpa kliniker med deras affärsutveckling  På sikt genomföra presentationer och produktdemonstrationer  Arbeta strukturerat med dokumentation och CRM-verktyg       Vi söker dig som    Har grundläggande erfarenhet av försäljning eller B2B-försäljning  Goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift  Innehav av B-körkort  Starkt personligt driv, ihärdighet och vilja att ständigt lära sig       Det är meriterande om du har    Erfarenhet från skönhets- eller klinikbranschen       För att lyckas i rollen har du följande personliga egenskaper:    Optimistisk  Målmedveten  Social  Ansvarstagande  Respektfull       Vår rekryteringsprocess   Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.     Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsproce

title: Facility Key Account Manager
location: Søborg, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Kom ikke til Elis, hvis du helst vil passe en kundeportefølje på autopilot. Men hvis du vil tæt på nogle af Danmarks største Facility-kunder, udvikle samarbejdet og skabe målbare resultater, så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.   Som Facility Key Account Manager får du ansvaret for en eksisterende portefølje af større Facility-kunder. Du bliver kundernes faste kommercielle sparringspartner med ansvar for at styrke relationerne, identificere nye forretningsmuligheder og sikre, at samarbejdet fungerer optimalt i hverdagen.  Du arbejder struktureret, strategisk og professionelt og kombinerer en stærk pionerånd med evnen til at opbygge relationer på alle niveauer hos kunden. Med energi, vedholdenhed og en langsigtet tilgang til kundeforhold fokuserer du både på fastholdelse og udvikling af forretningen. Du forstår, at stærke resultater skabes gennem tillid, værdiskabelse og et vedvarende fokus på kundens behov.   Det skal du især arbejde med     Udvikle og føre strategiske kundeplaner ud i livet.  Finde muligheder for mersalg og krydssalg på tværs af Elis’ serviceløsninger.  Drive prisreguleringer, genforhandlinger og andre initiativer, der skaber lønsom vækst.  Bruge data om kundernes forbrug og aftaler til at spotte forbedringer.  Have det samlede kontraktansvar og følge op på vilkår, servicemål og aftaler.  Håndtere kritiske kundeudfordringer og få samarbejdet tilbage på sporet, når det er nødvendigt.  Skabe et tæt samarbejde mellem kunden, salg, kundeservice og drift.  Planlægge din indsats og holde kunde-, aktivitets- og pipeline-data opdateret i CRM.     Det er en fordel, at du har     Erfaring med Key Account Management, kundeudvikling og strategisk salg.  Prøvet kræfter med større kunder og komplekse aftaler.  Stærke evner inden for forhandling og kommerciel dialog.  God økonomisk forståelse og gerne erfaring med prisoptimering, marginstyring eller business cases.  En struktureret arbejdsform og lyst til at skabe resultater gennem både relationer og forretning.  Trives godt med frihed under ansvar.     En salgsrolle med stor indflydelse, stærke kolleger og mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel hos kunderne. Lyder det som noget for dig?   Ja? Så er du på rette spor.   Hos Elis Får Du     Ansvar for en spændende og strategisk vigtig kundeportefølje.  Mulighed for at præge samarbejdet med nogle af Danmarks største Facility-kunder.  Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dygtige kolleger på tværs af salg og drift.  Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår og gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling.  En central rolle i en markedsledende virksomhed med høje ambitioner.     Hvis du er en holdspiller, bliver motiveret af at skabe resultater og vil have en salgsrolle med gode udviklingsmuligheder, så sæt kurs mod Elis.   Vil du høre mere om jobbet? description: About Agoda   At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.       Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.     No two days are the same at Agoda. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.    *Native/Fluent Japanese Language Level Required for this Position*    Strategic Accounts Management Team     Agoda is a travel booking platform and accommodation is at our core. As our accommodation partners are a key to our success, we work hard to ensure their success. That is why the Strategic Accounts Management (SAM) team in Agoda specializes in account management. We are direct contributors to what makes Agoda one of the market leaders because we understand accommodation needs and offer innovative solutions. From Bangkok to London and beyond, our team has footprints in over 50 locations around the world. title: Palvelupäällikkö valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen Vantaalle
description: RTK-Palvelu Oy on suomalainen kiinteistöpalvelujen monialayhtiö jo 50 vuoden kokemuksella. Yhtiön 3000 ammattilaista antaa asiakkailleen päivittäin mahdollisuuden keskittyä olennaiseen. Olemme aidosti ylpeitä liiketoimintamme jalommasta tarkoituksesta, jonka myötä olemme omistajamme kautta jo vuosikymmenten ajan tukeneet lasten ja nuorten urheilua ja hyvinvointia valtakunnallisesti.   Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset Haemme valtakunnalliseen asiakkuuteen palvelupäällikköä, joka osallistuu niin asiakkuuden ohjausryhmätyöskentelyyn kuin kentän operatiiviseen toimintaan. Tuet nimetyn siivousasiakkuuden palvelutuotantoa, esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä eri puolilla Suomea sekä huolehdit siitä, että sovitut toimintatavat toteutuvat yhdenmukaisesti. Toimipisteesi sijaitsee pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta tarvitset tehtävässä B-luokan ajokorttia, sillä työ edellyttää säännöllistä matkustamista eri paikkakunnille.Sinulla on vahvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita. Toimit luontevasti asiakkaan, oman organisaation ja eri yksiköiden kanssa ja viet sovitut asiat käytäntöön. Tehtävä edellyttää sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.Tehtävässä tarvitset kokemusta tiimien johtamisesta, henkilöstön innostamisesta ja yhteistyöstä yli organisaatiorajojen. Osaat johtaa toimintaa tavoitteellisesti sekä tukea esihenkilöitä ja henkilöstöä muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Arvostamme pitkää esihenkilökokemusta siivousalalta ja siivousalan erikoisammattitutkintoa.Tunnet siivouksen operatiivisen toiminnan, asiakkuuksien hoidon ja palvelusopimusten vaatimukset. Hallitset työssä tarvittavat järjestelmät ja hyödynnät tietoa toiminnan seurannassa, raportoinnissa, päätöksenteossa ja kehittämisessä. Varmistat palvelun laadun, sovittujen tavoitteiden toteutumisen ja arjen sujuvuuden yli yksikkörajojen. Tarvittaessa osallistut myös käytännön työhön kentällä.Kehität omaa työtäsi, palvelutuotantoa ja asiakkuutta pitkäjänteisesti yhdessä asiakkaan ja organisaation eri toimijoiden kanssa. Etsit käytännön ratkaisuja, joilla parannetaan laatua, tehokkuutta ja asiakaskokemusta. Työsi tueksi saat koko yrityksen tuen, ja työtä tehdään oikeasti yhdessä yli yksikkörajojen.   Tarjoamme Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Are you driven, results-oriented and a team player?   With 17,000+ retailers and restaurants in over 15 countries, StoreHub is on a mission to enable everyone, big or small, to build successful businesses.     At StoreHub, we're building a dream team whereby all of your colleagues are extraordinary at what they do and are highly effective collaborators.     It is in such a team that you learn the most, perform your best work, improve the fastest, and have the most fun.      If this is a journey you’d like to embark on, keep reading!      The  Customer Success Manager (CSM)  is a commercial leader responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of live merchant accounts. This includes executing contract renewals, driving account expansion (upsells, add-ons), and building long-term customer partnerships. CSMs are trusted merchant advisors and revenue owners, ensuring that merchants achieve their goals while maximizing financial outcomes for StoreHub.     You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Onboarding, Product, and Support to resolve key merchant issues, identify opportunities, and close high-impact commercial decisions.      Responsibilities:    Own the commercial success of your assigned portfolio of merchants — including pitching and closing renewals, expansions, and add-ons.  Develop and execute win/win negotiation strategies that maximize contract value while protecting and enhancing customer trust.  Partner with the Sales and Onboarding team to fully understand and develop a clear renewal strategy for each customer.  Confidently lead commercial conversations with merchant decision-makers, including pricing, feature packaging, and contractual terms.  Maximize account growth opportunities by playing a collaborative role in the account team and helping to drive incremental revenue.  Identify customer requirements, uncover roadblocks, and proactively drive on-time renewal closures.  Collaborate with internal resources such as Finance, Product, Marketing, and Business Intelligence teams to develop comprehensive win strategies.  Provide executive visibility into renewals and solicit leadership involvement where needed to close high-risk or high-value deals.  Maintain accurate forecasts and CRM hygiene across all renewal and expansion opportunities.  Act as a CSM brand ambassador by adopting new initiatives, mentoring teammates, and delivering strategic revenue outcomes. Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills.  Comfortable owning the full commercial lifecycle for assigned accounts — not just a relationship management role.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills with decision-makers.  Strategic mindset, process discipline, and data-driven decision making.  Strong customer management, including ability to navigate renewal resistance and product gaps

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.  
  Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers. 
   This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.   
  You should apply if:   
 
  You want to impact the industries that run our world:  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. 
  Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting:  The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. 
  You have innate curiosity in how businesses work:  One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center.   You are a life-long learner:  Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.  
  You build genuine relationships with your customers:  The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. 
  You want to be with the best:  Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best

title: Financial- & Projektcontroller (m/w/d)
description:
Über unseren Kunden

Unser Kunde steht für Innovation, Dynamik und technologischen Fortschritt. Am Standort im Norden von Frankfurt entwickelt und vertreibt das Unternehmen zukunftsweisende Roboterlösungen, die Branchen weltweit revolutionieren.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie sind seit einigen Jahren im Business- und Projektcontrolling tätig und möchten Ihre Expertise nun bei einem innovativen Marktführer im Bereich Robotik einbringen? Dann lassen Sie uns ins Gespräch kommen! In Ihrer neuen Rolle sind Sie nicht nur Zahlenverwalter, sondern strategischer Mitgestalter. Als Sparringspartner treiben Sie die wirtschaftliche Performance voran und sind maßgeblich an der Weiterentwicklung des Geschäftsbereiches beteiligt.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Rechnungswesen, Finanzen, BWL oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt- und Unternehmenscontrolling sowie fundierte Kenntnisse im Risikomanagement

  • Fundiertes Know-how im Projektgeschäft und nachweisbare Erfolge in der Steuerung komplexer Kostenstrukturen, der Produktivitätssteigerung und der Kapitalausstattung

  • Hohe Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie eine selbstständige, ergebnisorientierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Analytische und klare Kommunikation, auch in dynamischen Situationen, sowie verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Für ein wachstumsorientiertes Unternehmen im Raum Offenbach suchen wir einen Financial Controller (m/w/d), der finanzielle Planung und Analyse mit pragmatischer Beratung verbindet. Sie arbeiten eng mit Management und Fachbereichen zusammen, schaffen Klarheit über die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung und leiten daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

Aufgaben

  • Sie verantworten Budget, Forecast und Mehrjahresplanung und analysieren Abweichungen.

  • Sie bewerten Umsatz, Marge, Profitabilität, Cashflow und zentrale Werttreiber.

  • Sie entwickeln Management-Reporting, Kennzahlen und Steuerungsinstrumente weiter.

  • Sie erstellen Business Cases sowie Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen.

  • Sie beraten Management und Fachbereiche als Sparringspartner und leiten konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

Qualifikation

  • Sie haben ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling, Finance oder Rechnungswesen abgeschlossen.

  • Sie verfügen über mindestens fünf Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Controlling.

  • Sie sind mit Controlling in Unternehmensgruppen vertraut.

  • Sie arbeiten sehr sicher mit gängigen ERP-Systemen und Excel und setzen PowerPoint für Entscheidungsunterlagen ein.

  • Sie kommunizieren sicher mit dem Management und verfügen über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Bei Fragen steht Ihnen Herr Marcus Heinrich, unter der Rufnummer 0179 / 12 92 419 gerne zur Verfügung.

title: Senior Backend-Entwickler – Agents (100% Remote in Deutschland)
description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst

  • Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

title: Data Analist
description:
Zie jij snel welke data nodig is om een businessvraag te beantwoorden? Als Data Analist binnen het Data & AI Office analyseer je data, vertaal je vraagstukken uit de business naar concrete inzichten en help je collega’s om die inzichten te gebruiken voor betere beslissingen. Ook onderzoek je waar AI waarde kan toevoegen en werk je mee aan praktische toepassingen die de manier van werken verbeteren. 

Je bent de schakel tussen de business en de specialisten binnen Data & AI. Daarmee zorg je ervoor dat goede ideeën niet blijven hangen in analyses of experimenten, maar leiden tot oplossingen die medewerkers daadwerkelijk gebruiken en die waarde opleveren voor onze leden.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent analytisch sterk en oprecht nieuwsgierig naar wat er binnen de business speelt. Je neemt geen genoegen met de eerste vraag, maar onderzoekt welk probleem er werkelijk moet worden opgelost en welke informatie nodig is om een goede beslissing te nemen.

Je kunt schakelen tussen verschillende werelden. Je begrijpt de taal van de business, werkt zelf ook graag met data en kan goed samenwerken met technische dataspecialisten. Je hoeft niet zelf ieder model of datapipeline te bouwen, maar je begrijpt voldoende van data en AI om mogelijkheden te herkennen, inhoudelijke vragen te stellen en resultaten kritisch te beoordelen.

Je communiceert helder en overtuigend. Je kunt complexe analyses eenvoudig uitleggen en helpt collega’s om inzichten en AI-oplossingen op een goede manier toe te passen. Daarbij ben je organisatiesensitief, verbindend en resultaatgericht. Je neemt eigenaarschap en blijft betrokken totdat een oplossing daadwerkelijk wordt gebruikt en waarde toevoegt.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Wil jij bouwen aan betrouwbare dataproducten die door heel Univé worden gebruikt? Binnen het Data & AI Office werk je met Snowflake, dbt, Azure, Git en CI/CD. Je maakt van beschikbare brondata goed gemodelleerde, geteste en beheersbare dataproducten voor analyses, rapportages, self-service en AI-toepassingen.

We zoeken een Data Engineer die data engineering combineert met software-engineering. Iemand die verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor wat hij of zij bouwt, nieuwe technologie praktisch inzet en samen met collega’s het dataplatform en onze werkwijze verder ontwikkelt.

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een Data Engineer die technische kwaliteit belangrijk vindt en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor wat je bouwt. Je zoekt actief naar manieren om ontwikkeling slimmer, beter en beter beheersbaar te maken en gebruikt nieuwe technologie wanneer die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt.

Je schrijft begrijpelijke en onderhoudbare code en automatiseert waar dat helpt. Voor jou is een dataproduct pas klaar wanneer het betrouwbaar, getest, gedocumenteerd en beheersbaar in productie staat.

Je werkt graag samen en kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen. Je deelt kennis, staat open voor feedback en begrijpt dat een goede technische oplossing ook bruikbaar en begrijpelijk moet zijn voor de organisatie.

Wat neem je mee?

  • hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met een opleiding in Informatica, Data Engineering, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • meerdere jaren relevante ervaring als Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer of in een vergelijkbare technische datafunctie;

  • sterke kennis van SQL en datamodellering;

  • ervaring met Snowflake en dbt of vergelijkbare cloud- en transformatietechnologie;

  • ervaring met Microsoft Azure

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. title: Billing Subject Matter Expert- Support
description:
Elation Health is deeply committed to helping independent primary care practices take better care of their patients. Since 2010, we've built a clinical-first, collaborative EHR platform — and with the addition of Elation Billing, we're bringing that same clinical-first philosophy to the revenue side of the practice, so billing works with the chart instead of around it.

Elation Health is searching for a Support Subject Matter Expert in Elation Billing — someone who has already done real medical billing and revenue cycle management work, not someone learning it on the job. This is a hands-on, case-based role embedded directly in our support queue: you'll bring practitioner-level RCM judgment to the billing cases our Technical Support Specialists can't fully resolve through process or AI-assisted troubleshooting alone, and you'll help the rest of the team get sharper at spotting those cases in the first place.

This isn't a back-office consulting role. You'll be working live cases day to day alongside our support team, diagnosing whether an issue is a product bug, a payer-specific quirk, or a mismatch between how a practice actually operates and how they've configured their billing workflow — then resolving it with the kind of judgment that only comes from having sat inside a claims lifecycle before.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Elation Billing product line's embedded RCM expert, owning complex billing and revenue cycle cases that require practitioner-level judgment — claims lifecycle issues, CPT/ICD-10 coding logic, payer adjudication and denial patterns, A/R and collections workflows.
  • Act as the go-to resource for case swarms and escalations within Elation Billing whenever a Technical Support Specialist's investigation surfaces a billing nuance beyond scripted troubleshooting.
  • Diagnose a practice's underlying billing context — payment model (insurance-taking vs. DPC), staffing structure, and prior workflow choices — to distinguish genuine product issues from configuration or workflow mismatches, rather than treating every case as a symptom in isolation.
  • Partner with Product and Prod Dev, turning recurring billing edge cases, payer-specific patterns, and denial trends into structured feedback that can inform the roadmap.
  • Contribute to and maintain the team's billing-related knowledge base, SOPs, and macros, and help calibrate the AI Case Assistant's billing-related suggestions so resolutions compound across the team rather than living only in your own case history.
  • Help build the broader team's baseline RCM literacy — sharing real-world billing context so Specialists can better anticipate the issues different practice types are prone to.
  • Track and report on billing-case quality and resolution metrics within your scope, and flag systemic patterns

description:
Elation is building the technology platform that powers the new era of primary care. Our Clinical-First® EHR is beloved by physicians and is enabling the transition to value-based care. We're a mission-driven team committed to empowering independent primary care physicians and improving the quality of care for patients.

Accelerate Agentic Billing velocity. Your hands-on primary care coding and RCM expertise (e.g., AdvancedMD, Athena, or similar billing solutions) lets our team iterate on AI billing features with fast, credible domain feedback instead of waiting on live-customer validation for every coding or claims decision.

As AI authorship of billing decisions grows, you'll evaluate and safeguard accuracy and practice trust. You're the billing analog to the clinical-safety role our Clinical SMEs play for clinical AI.

What You'll Do

User Zero Testing — Feedback & Insight

Test new AI billing capabilities (coding suggestions, Auto-Queue, Worklist, ERA/payment posting) before wider release, evaluating them against real coding and billing judgment. You'll be the first eyes on every billing feature, providing the credible feedback that shapes the product.

Front-line Context & Grounding

Bring firsthand experience of how competitor and adjacent billing systems handle the same workflows, so our billing teams build with the broader RCM landscape in view — not just Elation's current implementation. Help us understand what "best in class" looks like.

Billing Evaluation & Success Criteria

Define what "correct" means for coding and billing outputs — a billing-specific subset of user success criteria — and pressure-test AI-generated billing outputs before they reach practices. Your judgment protects practices from billing mistakes.

Design Partner

Sit alongside Product Design as a billing co-designer, providing billing and coding context and success criteria directly into the design process. Help architect workflows for process excellence by providing a high-level view of industry standards and differentiators.

„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance.

Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one.

You will:

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

description:

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you.

On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

You will work to accommodate all aspects of an environment to drive real technical outcomes for our customers.

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer - World Map
description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

You'll help build the geometric foundation of the next-generation world map — joining our World Map Research Engineering team (Geospatial Alignment) as a Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer. This is an end-to-end applied research role that spans from strong engineering and data-systems work to R&D in 3D deep learning, transformers, and foundation models. You'll develop new algorithms, produce the research data and evaluation assets needed to advance them, and engineer the resulting capabilities into dependable production systems.

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role covers the cell side of our protein characterisation work. You would keep the cell lines healthy and run the assays that show how a designed protein behaves on a living cell, week after week, to the same standard.

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

You will run cell culture and the cell-based assays for our protein characterisation work. That means the mammalian lines the assays depend on, from thaw through routine passage to a banked and documented stock, and the weekly rhythm of seeding, treating, reading and reporting plates.

Most of it runs in 384-well plates with imaging-based or flow cytometry readouts. You will run those assays as designed, with the controls and replicates that make a curve defensible, and you will be the person who notices when a plate, a line or a reagent lot has started to drift.

AI systems are moving from proof of concepts into the infrastructure of everyday life. That creates a fundamental technical problem: how do you know an increasingly autonomous AI system is secure, reliable and behaving as intended? And who do you trust to answer that question?

title: Junior Transformation Strategist (UK Based)
description:
About Duvo

Before Duvo, our founders built and ran a $2 billion retailer. They saw how much critical work still depended on spreadsheets, inboxes, supplier portals and the memory of experienced operators. The real process rarely lived in one system. People held the last mile together.

Duvo is building the Enterprise Execution OS: the shared layer that understands how work really runs, carries it across existing systems and measures the business result.

Our agents do the work, not just suggest the next step. They gather evidence, make decisions within agreed rules, route exceptions to the right person and update the source system. People keep control wherever judgment or approval is needed. Every action leaves an audit trail.

We start with one recurring process and a clear outcome. Every solution carries a contracted 5x ROI guarantee.

The role

As a Junior Transformation Strategist, you are the insight and output engine beside our Transformation Strategists on our largest accounts.

On bigger engagements we need more than technical delivery. We need someone who can take a messy process, find the critical question, get to a clear insight fast, and put it into materials a customer team will act on. Today that work often lands on Forward Deployed Engineers. That is the wrong use of a scarce technical resource. This role exists so that insight work has a dedicated owner.

You will work alongside Transformation Strategists (who own day-to-day account presence and workstream direction) and Forward Deployed Engineers (who own the technical solution). You do not own the executive relationship or the commercial outcome. You own the speed and quality of the analytical and written work that makes those conversations possible.

Vega is looking for a Full Stack Developer to build features end to end across our platform from Java/Spring Boot services and APIs to React and TypeScript interfaces – using AI tools as a core part of how they work and helping bring AI-powered capabilities into the product.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry's first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done – from the start of an investor's journey to its end. title: Customer Success Team Lead
description: Be part of a movement that moves the world    At ASICS, we’re more than just a brand; we're a movement. A movement of movement, propelled by the belief that motion strengthens the body and uplifts the mind. Our name itself, an acronym for "Anima Sana in Corpore Sano" (a Sound Mind in a Sound Body), encapsulates this commitment. Since taking our first step in Japan in 1949, our journey has been about more than just reaching the finish lines or clocking the fastest times. It's about the joy of moving and it's open to all.  If you're inspired to move yourself and the world toward a brighter, more inclusive future, we're looking for you.  Here at ASICS, we welcome diversity in our people, their backgrounds and life experiences. So, you could be the right person for this role regardless of your age, nationality, religious beliefs, or gender identification.    Your role in our shared journey    As  Customer Success Team Lead  located at our Nordic ASICS Head Office in Gothenburg, Sweden, you’ll lead and drive strategic customer success initiatives across wholesale operations, serving as the primary liaison between ASICS and key wholesale accounts.  This leadership position is responsible for maximizing revenue growth, optimizing Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, and developing high-performing teams while fostering strategic partnerships that drive long-term business success across the Nordic market.  Your role will be instrumental in weaving the fabric of our movement, bringing unique perspectives and driving innovation with every step. In the role, you’ll be reporting into our Head of Order to Cash North.    Can you move minds?    We’re looking for a candidate who can proactively drive growth and operational excellence by leading cross-functional customer success and customer service initiatives, developing high-performing teams, and fostering transformational partnerships that position ASICS as the preferred brand partner while delivering sustainable competitive advantage in the Nordic market.    Reporting to the Head of Order to Cash North, as part of the role you’ll:       Define and implement the local Customer Success vision in the Nordic market fully aligned with the company goals and the Commercial and Operational strategies    Drive transformation from an operational to a revenue-& contribution margin oriented and customer focused Customer Service culture    Translate company operational and commercial strategy into customer-specific value propositions    Lead, coach and develop the Customer Success team unlocking performance, confidence and potential    Own team hiring, performance management, team engagement initiatives and strategic enablement    Collaborate cross-functionally with Commercial, Merchandising, Finance and logistic teams to advocate for the customer and increase operational efficiency    Develop and implement Standard Operating Procedures to increase local efficiency strictly in-line with the O2C policies and guidelines

description: Myymäläpäällikkö Mikkeli Graanin Mustiin ja Mirriin   Musti Group on Pohjoismaiden johtava lemmikkieläinhoidon asiantuntija, joka toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Norjassa, sekä vuodesta 2024 lähtien myös Baltiassa. Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme täyden palvelun tuotetarjoaja ja toimija – sekä fyysisesti että digitaalisesti. Uskomme, että täyden palvelun ekosysteemi tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen arvolupauksen, joka parantaa ja vahvistaa hyviä asiakassuhteita ja erottaa meidät kilpailijoista.    Musti-konsernin liikevaihto oli 561 miljoonaa euroa tilikaudella 2024 (15 kk). Yhtiöllä oli  tilikauden 2024 lopussa 2 178 työntekijää, 1,9 miljoonaa asiakasta ja 415 myymälää.    Nyt etsimme laumanjäseneksi uutta myymäläpäällikköä!   Myymäläpäällikkönä toimit tulosvastuullisena myymälänvetäjänä, vastaten myymälästä ja myymälän tiimin arjen sujuvuudesta. Omalla esimerkilläsi kehität myymälän myönteistä, asiakaslähtöistä ilmapiiriä, palveluasennetta ja johdat myymälää määriteltyjen tavoitteiden mukaisesti. Olet myös mukana päivittäisessä myyntityössä.   Mustilla myymäläpäällikön tehtäviin kuuluu     Kokonaistulosvastuu omasta myymälästäsi: Myymälän avainlukujen seuranta ja raportointi, kannattavuuden varmistaminen ja myynnin kehittäminen ovat tärkeä osa työtäsi  Esihenkilövastuut: mm. rekrytointi, perehdytys, työvuorosuunnittelu sekä henkilöstön ohjaaminen ja kehittäminen  Myyntiin ja asiakaspalveluun liittyvät tehtävät: Myymäläpäällikkönä työnkuvaasi kuuluu myös myymälän päivittäiset askareet kuten kuormanpurku ja hyllyttäminen sekä myymäläkuntoisuudesta huolehtiminen.  Vastuu ketjukonseptin toteutumisesta myymälässäsi ja yhteisten toimintatapojen noudattamisesta: Huolehdit, että myymäläsi ja sen henkilökunta toimivat linjassa yrityksen toimintaohjeiden mukaisesti  Huolehdit myymäläsi päivittäisestä sisäisestä viestinnästä: Henkilökunta on tietoinen ketjun, alueen ja myymälän tärkeistä ajankohtaisista asioista ja tavoitteista      Odotamme sinulta     Aikaisempaa kokemusta myynti- ja asiakaspalvelutyöstä: Kokemus erityisesti kaupan –tai palvelualan tehtävistä katsotaan eduksi.  Tahtoa ja rohkeutta työskennellä esihenkilötehtävissä: Esihenkilötyö kiinnostaa sinua aidosti ja haluat tukea ja ohjata tiimiläisiä yhä parempiin suorituksiin ja johtaa tiimiäsi. Arvostammekin aiempaa kokemusta esihenkilötehtävistä.  Kommunikointitaitoja sekä innostunutta asennetta: Olet selkeä ja tehokas viestimään sekä johdat omalla esimerkilläsi myönteistä ilmapiiriä  Sitoutuneisuutta ja vastuunkantoa omasta myymälästäsi ja sen tuloksista: Huolehdit toiminnallasi, että myymäläsi pääsee asetettuihin tavoitteisiin ja olet oma-aloitteisesti valmis jatkuvasti kehittämään myymälän toimintaa  Järjestelmällisyyttä, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä ratkaisukeskeisyyttä: Myymälän organisointi ja tiimin johtaminen edellyttää päivittäisten tilanteiden ratkomista sekä pitkän

title: Front Office Manager
description: Wir bewahren die Tradition, zu den Besten zu gehören.      Mitten im Herzen Wiens wird das Hotel Sacher Wien seit 1876 zur Bühne für besondere Momente – vom glanzvollen Wiener Opernball bis zu unzähligen Begegnungen mit Gästen aus aller Welt.     Als eines der Top 50 Hotels weltweit und ausgezeichnet mit dem Forbes Travel Guide Rating zählt das Hotel Sacher zu den führenden Adressen der internationalen Hotellerie. Diese Anerkennung ist für uns Auszeichnung und Ansporn zugleich.     Möglich wird all dies durch Menschen, die mit ihrem Engagement das Sacher zu dem machen, was es heute ist. Ob die besonderen Momente, die unseren Gästen in Erinnerung bleiben, oder die vielen Details, die oft unbemerkt bleiben und doch unverzichtbar sind – hinter all dem stehen Menschen, die unser Haus mit Leidenschaft, Exzellenz und Persönlichkeit prägen. Menschen, die Tradition bewahren, neue Ideen einbringen und gemeinsam das Sacher jeden Tag ein Stück weit mitgestalten. Vielleicht schon bald gemeinsam mit Ihnen.      So sieht Ihr Tag aus:    Aktive Mitgestaltung und Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Tagesablaufs am Front Office, in der Telefonzentrale und im Guest Services  Stellvertretung des Assistant Head of Experience in dessen Abwesenheit  Führung, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung unseres Empfangsteams, der Telefonzentrale und Guest Services. title: Customer Service Manager
description: Manage your own Customer Service team   Join our growing company!   Based in Auckland     We are seeking a full-time Front Office Supervisor (referred to as Customer Service Manager internally) to join our team at UniLodge Auckland Central. You will be responsible for managing a small operations team, working together to manage daily operations, oversight of the maintenance program and leasing of our student apartments.   About The Role     Full-time position - 40 hours per week across Monday to Sunday  Manage the day-to-day administrative operations   Manage and develop a team of high-performing staff   Build and maintain relationships with each key stakeholder group (investors and key learning institutions)   Working with the Leasing Agent in relation to leasing   Ongoing management of the apartments including inspections and maintenance requests   Working alongside the General Manager on the property’s day to day financial performance. title: Guests Services Lead
description: JOB PURPOSE:   To lead Ilmi's Guest Services function by delivering exceptional experiences for VIP and VVIP guests, coordinating visit protocols, facilitating seamless engagement with internal and external stakeholders, and overseeing daily operations in line with Ilmi's hospitality and professional standards.      KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ACCOUNTABILITIES:    Plan, coordinate, and oversee VIP and VVIP visits, ensuring a seamless end-to-end guest experience.  Develop, implement, and maintain guest service standards, protocols, and operating procedures.  Coordinate with the Protocol, Executive Office, and relevant stakeholder teams to plan and execute official visits.  Manage visit schedules, itineraries, logistics, access requirements, and hospitality arrangements for distinguished guests.  Serve as the primary point of coordination for all VIP and VVIP visit requirements.  Ensure every guest touchpoint reflects Ilmi's brand values, hospitality standards, and commitment to service excellence.  Lead daily Guest Services operations and supervise the delivery of all related activities. Análisis y seguimiento de indicadores de rendimiento (KPI) , evaluando tiempos de respuesta, plazos de resolución, incidencias recurrentes, costes de reparación y satisfacción del cliente.   Control y optimización de los costes del departamento , buscando soluciones eficientes en la gestión de garantías, repuestos, transportes y servicios técnicos.
