title: (Senior) Freight Forwarder - Air Export
description:
In deze functie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het voorbereiden en organiseren van export luchtvrachtzendingen conform de specificatie van de klant en richtlijnen van Geodis.

Je bent het centrale punt in een dynamisch proces. Je communiceert met klanten, leveranciers, kantoren en agenten. Je maakt afspraken met vervoerders en airlines conform de wensen van de klant. Hierbij probeer je proactief te zorgen dat marges worden vergroot zonder dat dit ten koste gaat van de kwaliteit die je levert.

Als accuraat persoon zorg je ervoor dat de data die je in het systeem invoert altijd correct is. Ook zorg je ervoor dat alle luchtvracht gerelateerde documenten en facturen foutloos worden opgemaakt.

Na een gedegen inwerkperiode zal er sprake zijn van periodieke standby/weekenddiensten.

Daarnaast ligt onze focus op jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling binnen het vakgebied.


Wij zijn op zoek naar een leuke, enthousiaste, leergierige Freight Forwarder met goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels in woord en geschrift. Je bent communicatief vaardig en je hebt gedegen kennis van de Freight Forwarding Industrie. Je hebt MBO+ werkervaring, bent in het bezit van een geldige VGB & MLV en je hebt een probleemoplossende instelling. 

Voor aanvang van het dienstverband zal er een VGB aanvraag worden gestart.

title: Head of Product
description:
As Head of Product, your mission is to lead the product organization that builds what our users bank with every day, ensuring they get the safe, smart and effortless banking they expect.

Why this matters:
At bunq, our mission is to Make Life Easy, for our users, our teams, and the world around us.

Every team plays a unique role in making this mission a reality. The Product team does this by building and improving the products our users bank with, while keeping them safe and compliant.

As Head of Product, you contribute by setting product direction and leading the product leaders who deliver it, helping us grow as the bank of The Free.

Take ownership:
As Head of Product, you’ll take charge of key responsibilities that directly impact bunq’s growth and our users’ seamless experience:

  • Grow our users’ use of bunq’s products by leading product strategy and delivery for your area.

  • Keep growth and safety moving together, so that fraud, compliance and quality are built into the products rather than bolted on.

  • Build a strong, AI-first product organization by leading Product Owners and Team Leads, and redesigning how the function works around AI agents instead of adding headcount by default.

  • Be bunq’s product voice with the management board, regulators, auditors and partners.


  • You’ve led a technical product organization and can get hands-on when needed. Size of organization isn’t the bar.

  • You have product leadership experience in a regulated financial services setting.

  • You understand payments and fraud, and you have data analysis skills and engineering depth.

  • You have experience working with regulators and across multiple markets.

  • You’re skilled at stakeholder management at management-board level.<

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Ben jij een Senior Mechanical Engineer die impact wil maken in uitdagende Life Sciences projecten? Ontwerp geavanceerde, duurzame werktuigbouwkundige installaties voor hightech laboratoria of geclassificeerde productiefaciliteiten, waar jouw expertise echt het verschil maakt. Bij Deerns krijg je de ruimte om complexe projecten te leiden en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van wetenschap en gezondheidszorg-tech laboratoria.

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Mechanical Engineer binnen de Life Sciences speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerp van complexe en technisch uitdagende productiefaciliteiten, laboratoria, cleanrooms en hightech onderzoeksomgevingen. Jij vertaalt klantwensen naar betrouwbare, energie-efficiënte en toekomstbestendige werktuigbouwkundige installaties van HVACsystemen en luchtbehandeling tot proceskoeling, stoom, water- en gassystemen.

In de rol van Senior Engineer neem je bovendien de volledige ontwerpverantwoordelijkheid op je en fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor zowel klant als ontwerpteam. Vanaf de conceptfase denk je mee over technische oplossingen die voldoen aan de strengste normen binnen Life Sciences, zoals GMP-richtlijnen, biosafety eisen en hoge duurzaamheidsstandaarden. Je werkt nauw samen met andere disciplines in multidisciplinaire projectteams en bewaakt de kwaliteit en samenhang van het totale ontwerp.  

 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Meedenken in de vroege ontwerp en conceptfase van projecten, zoals laboratoria, cleanrooms en productiefaciliteiten.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer
description:
Heb jij diepgaande ervaring in elektrotechnische installaties en wil je bijdragen aan de meest kritische en innovatieve datacenterprojecten van dit moment? Als Senior Electrical Engineer Datacenters bij Deerns werk je aan high‑tech, schaalbare en energie‑efficiënte faciliteiten die de digitale wereld draaiend houden. Jij ontwerpt de elektrotechnische systemen die maximale betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid en continuïteit waarborgen precies waar de datacentersector om vraagt. 

 

De uitdaging

Denk aan middenspannings- en laagspanningsverdelers, UPS‑systemen, generatoren, noodstroomconcepten, earthing & bonding, automatisering, beveiligingssystemen, energieopwekking en power monitoring die 24/7 betrouwbaar moeten functioneren.

Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam.

title: Teamleider en Senior Adviseur Brandveiligheid
description:
Ben jij een ervaren Adviseur Brandveiligheid die niet alleen excelleert in complexe, grootschalige projecten, maar ook graag het voortouw neemt in het aansturen, coachen en laten groeien van een team? In deze rol combineer je inhoudelijke expertise met leiderschap en speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van ons team Brandveiligheid.

 

De uitdaging 
Als Teamleider Brandveiligheid bij Deerns sta jij aan het roer van een groeiend team van specialisten en geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan. Het team bestaat momenteel uit een mix van ervaren experts en talentvolle adviseurs en bevindt zich in een fase van sterke groei. Aan jou de uitdaging om deze groei in goede banen te leiden, het team verder uit te bouwen en te versterken zowel in omvang als in kwaliteit en positionering.

Je combineert strategisch leiderschap met inhoudelijke diepgang en bent bepalend voor de kwaliteit, koers en groei van het team. Je creëert een omgeving waarin professionals excelleren, kennis wordt gedeeld en innovatie wordt gestimuleerd.

Brandveiligheid zit in ieder project. Of het nu gaat om de nieuwbouw van een ziekenhuis, een ‘state of the art’ cleanroom, de bouw van een (houten) woontoren, of de nieuwbouw, renovatie of transformatie van een (multi-tenant) kantoorcomplex. In al deze ontwerpen speelt brandveiligheid een cruciale rol.

In de rol van adviseur opereer je op senior niveau en werk je aan complexe brandveiligheidsvraagstukken binnen al onze adviesgroepen: Gezondheidszorg, Clean Technology, Vastgoed en Luchthavens. Dit zorgt voor een grote variatie aan aansprekende projecten, nationaal en internationaal.

title: Marketing & Communicatie Meewerkstagiair
description:
Ben jij een HBO marketing- of communicatiestudent die praktijkervaring wil opdoen binnen een internationaal en innovatief ingenieursbureau dat bijdraagt aan de gebouwen van de toekomst? Bij Deerns krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan digitale content, campagnes, websites en interne communicatie. Je ontwikkelt waardevolle vaardigheden op het gebied van marketingtechnologie, contentmanagement en projectcoördinatie binnen een internationale organisatie die actief is in negen landen. 

 

De uitdaging 

Tijdens jouw stage ondersteun je het Marketing & Communications-team bij uiteenlopende marketingactiviteiten. Je werkt mee aan websitebeheer, online campagnes, contentmigraties en interne communicatie. Daarnaast krijg je de kans om ervaring op te doen met marketing automation, CMS-systemen en internationale marketingprojecten. Een ideale stage voor studenten die willen ontdekken hoe marketing en communicatie bijdragen aan de groei van een multinational. 


Dit ga je doen
Tijdens jouw meewerkstage ga je aan de slag met uiteenlopende Marketing & Communications-werkzaamheden. Jij ondersteunt onder andere bij: 

Website & Digital Content Support

  • Uitvoeren van kwaliteitscontroles en contentreviews voor de Deerns-website tijdens contentmigraties. 

  • Ondersteunen bij het categoriseren van content binnen het CMS.

title: Enterprise IT Architect (m/w/d) – Industrie & Fertigung
description:
Über Strategy & Transformation Consulting GmbH

Strategy & Transformation Consulting (S&T) ist eine unabhängige Strategie- und Transformationsberatung und unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, die Opportunitäten der digitalen Transformation stets in Hinblick auf eine Effizienzsteigerung oder zur Erweiterung bzw. Gewinnung von neuen Geschäftsfeldern erfolgreich zu nutzen sowie die notwendigen Veränderungen aktiv zu gestalten. Wir gestalten und implementieren signifikante Transformationen End2End durch das Beherrschen des digitalen Fortschritts. Dabei hilft uns unser Technologieverständnis sowie langjährige Business Erfahrung aus vielen erfolgreich durchgeführten Transformationen. Weitere Informationen über uns finden Sie unter www.strategy-transformation.com.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort in unbefristeter Festanstellung (Vollzeit, Remote in Deutschland mit Präsenzterminen beim Kunden) zwei Enterprise IT Architects (m/w/d) – Industrie & Fertigung.

Deine Aufgabe

Du gestaltest bei Industriekunden die Unternehmens-IT-Architektur entlang der Wertschöpfung: von der Produktentwicklung über die Arbeitsvorbereitung und Fertigung bis in Service und Vertrieb. Du nimmst bestehende Anwendungs- und Datenlandschaften auf, analysierst Geschäftsprozesse, Datenflüsse und Schnittstellen zwischen den Kernsystemen (ERP, MES, Engineering- und Produktdatensysteme, CAD, CRM) und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und IT das Zielbild: Welche Systeme führen welche Daten, wie fließen Produktstrukturen, Stücklisten, Aufträge und Änderungen durchgängig durch das Unternehmen, wo liegen Medienbrüche und wie werden sie geschlossen. Ship global, pay local. Mit pakajo machen wir internationalen Versand für E-Commerce-Unternehmen einfacher, transparenter und wirtschaftlicher.

title: Full-Stack & Mobile Engineer
description:
Intro

For this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria.

Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference.

Tasks

As a Full-Stack & Mobile Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will build our product on the web and on the phone in the customer's hand. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, developing and maintaining our web application with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS and TypeScript: the flow editor, call analytics, billing and partner tools.
  • Building our native companion app with Expo / React Native or Swift.
  • Building features across the stack, from the user interface to the database with Prisma and PostgreSQL, and the Python services behind them.
  • Owning features end to end: turning customer needs into requirements, shipping them and checking that they help.
  • Applying DevOps practices to support development and deployment, including Docker and, when appropriate, Kubernetes.
  • Participating in technical discussions, code reviews and architectural planning.

Requirements

Experience:

Any relevant experience in web or mobile development is welcome; we are open to junior, mid-level and senior candidates who demonstrate strong practical skills and a willingness to learn.

Technical Skills:

Required:

  • Proficiency with Next.js, React and TypeScript.
  • Experience building mobile apps with Expo / Reac

title: Voice AI Engineer
description:
Intro

For this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria.

Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference.

Tasks

As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving turn-taking: when the agent speaks, waits, yields or gets interrupted, including voice activity and end-of-turn detection.
  • Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless.
  • Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests.
  • Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio.
  • Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices.
  • Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps.

Requirements

Experience:

A senior or strong mid-level engineer with production experience in real-time audio, conversational AI or ML model serving.

Technical Skills:

Required:

  • Strong Python, including asyncio and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on work with speech (STT, TTS, VAD) and LLM APIs in latency-sensitive systems.
  • Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits.

title: iOS Software Engineer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

2. Chef d’équipe ou de secteur production, 4 à 5 mois. Une équipe de 3 à 10 personnes, la performance de cette équipe est votre responsabilité.

Changement de site, au bout d’environ 12 mois

Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. title: Co-founder / Treuhänder/in – let's build the Treuhand of 2030
description:
Build the Treuhand of 2030.

Co-founder wanted: certified fiduciary (Treuhänder/in).

We believe that by 2030 at the latest, AI agents will handle most routine work in a Treuhand. That leaves fiduciaries with the work that needs judgment: reviewing, advising clients and signing off.

We are founding that Treuhand for Swiss startups and SMEs. AI agents prepare the work, and a qualified fiduciary signs off everything that goes to clients and authorities.

Underneath runs a finance stack built for agents, with clean data, a full audit trail and connections to the systems clients already use. Long term, we aim to run our clients' whole finance function on this stack, from bookkeeping to reporting, planning and investor/board updates.

Where we stand

The company is not founded yet. We are testing the problem in interviews with founders, CFOs and fiduciaries, three startups are interested in a paid pilot, and we have built a first prototype. You would join from day one and build the company with me. We will add a technical co-founder at a later stage.

Who you would work with

I'm Jonas Baer, two-time entrepreneur and fractional CFO for Swiss startups. As a Venturelab trainer and Innosuisse expert, I work closely with Swiss founders, the clients we want to serve. Before that I was CFO and director at a startup where we grew revenue to almost CHF 10M and the team to over 40. I studied Business Informatics at UZH and bridge finance and IT (linkedin.com/in/jonas-baer).

What you would do

  • Decide which workflows we automate first, where the AI acts alone and where a fiduciary signs

  • Teach the agents Swiss practice (MWST, AHV/BVG/UVG, booking rules) and test them on real documents

  • Serve the first pilot clients yourself

  • Build and lead the operations team as we scale

You have the final say on what gets booked, filed and signed.

title: Flight Test Instrumentation & Data Engineer
description:
The Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & Data Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end handling, quality assurance, accessibility, and long-term management of all flight data. The primary objective is to ensure that full-aircraft data, from the onboard sensors and DAQ systems to the final processing tools, is available to every engineering team through a reliable, efficient, and standardized workflow.

Tasks

Flight Test Instrumentation (FTI) & DAQ Pipeline

  • Manage the data pipeline from the physical sensor and Data Acquisition (DAQ) level for the full aircraft, ensuring seamless and accurate transmission into the telemetry and storage systems.
  • Maintain sensor configuration, calibration records, and metadata to guarantee the accurate translation of raw physical signals into usable engineering units.
  • Collaborate with hardware, software and integration teams to define sensor requirements, DAQ architectures, scaling, and telemetry bandwidth allocations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data anomalies at the DAQ and sensor level (e.g., signal noise, dropouts, faulty scaling) before they propagate into downstream databases.

Data Infrastructure & Accessibility

  • Maintain reliable extraction of flight data from InfluxDB.
  • Develop and maintain standardized local data structures for analysis, plotting, and visualization.
  • Optimize access to large flight datasets while minimizing CPU and memory usage.
  • Design and maintain an efficient local storage solution for processed flight data.
  • Support future improvements to the flight data architecture as storage requirements, sensor counts, and analysis needs continue to evolve.

Data Quality & Analysis Support

  • Maintain derived datasets to ensure common calculations and signals are shared consistently across teams.
  • Ensure strict timing sync

Vous avez parfois l’impression de ne plus totalement vous reconnaître dans votre vie professionnelle actuelle ?

De donner beaucoup…
sans réellement vous sentir épanoui(e) ?

Certaines personnes ne cherchent pas simplement un nouveau travail.
Elles cherchent un nouveau souffle.
Un projet plus humain.
Plus aligné.
Plus libre.

Aujourd’hui, je développe une équipe de personnes souhaitant évoluer dans le domaine du bien-être, du développement personnel et de l’accompagnement humain.

Je recherche des personnes ambitieuses, sincères et motivées, qui ont envie de construire quelque chose de durable tout en évoluant personnellement.

Vos missions

🌿 Développer progressivement une activité autour du bien-être et de l’accompagnement humain
🌿 Créer des relations humaines authentiques et accompagner des personnes dans leur évolution
🌿 Participer à des formations et développer ses compétences en communication, leadership et développement personnel
🌿 Utiliser les réseaux sociaux et les outils digitaux de manière simple et accessible
🌿 Évoluer au sein d’une équipe positive, ambitieuse et bienveillante

Vos compétences

✨ Aucune expérience obligatoire
✨ Être motivé(e), sérieux(se) et prêt(e) à apprendre
✨ Aimer le contact humain et le développement personnel
✨ Avoir envie d’évoluer dans un environnement positif
✨ Être ouvert(e) à une nouvelle façon de travailler plus flexible et humaine

Avantages

🤍 Activité flexible et évolutive
🤍 Télétravail possible
🤍 Accompagnement personnalisé étape par étape
🤍 Formations et outils inclus
🤍 Développement personnel et leadership
🤍 Environnement humain, stimulant et motivant
🤍 Possibilité de construire un projet durable à son rythme

Ce projet peut convenir à une personne en reconversion, en quête de sens ou simplement à quelqu’un qui ressent qu’il est temps de reprendre sa vie professionnelle autrement.<

title: Chargé(e) des relations investisseurs h/f - Stage 6 mois
description:
Tokimo est une plateforme de crowdfunding immobilier née d'un constat simple : la formation seule ne suffit pas à faire passer les gens à l'action. Notre mission ? Rendre l'investissement immobilier simple, ludique et accessible à tous, en quelques clics depuis un smartphone.

Fort d'une communauté de dizaines de milliers de personnes formées et d'une image forte sur les réseaux sociaux, Tokimo connecte investisseurs particuliers et professionnels de l'immobilier pour financer des projets concrets, quel que soit le contexte bancaire.

🎯 Vos missions

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle investisseurs, vous interviendrez sur deux axes complémentaires : le développement commercial et la gestion de la relation investisseurs.

Vos missions

Vous serez le premier visage de Tokimo pour nos investisseurs : celui qui convainc, rassure, accompagne et fidélise. Un rôle à 360°, au carrefour du business development, de la relation client et des opérations — sans routine, avec de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour.

Transformer les curieux en investisseurs convaincus
Vous prenez en charge les nouveaux inscrits sur la plateforme, les accompagnez pas à pas dans leur premier investissement et construisez avec eux une relation de confiance durable. Appels, emails, relances : vous maîtrisez tous les canaux pour convertir et fidéliser.

title: Stage Ouvrier - Assemblage de Batteries chez 40Watts - JUILLET 2026
description:
40Watts, entreprise spécialisée dans le reconditionnement de batteries pour vélos électriques, recherche un ou une stagiaire pour se joindre à notre équipe compacte et dynamique à Guer.

Nous sommes une entreprise engagée dans l’innovation durable et nous offrons un cadre adapté pour développer des compétences pratiques en assemblage de batteries.

Vos missions

Vos missions principales seront :

- participer à l’assemblage de batteries pour vélos électriques ;

- ouvrir et fermer les batteries ;

- collaborer étroitement avec notre petite équipe pour apprendre et appliquer des techniques de production ;

- s’impliquer dans les différents aspects de la production, de la découpe au soudage ;

- utiliser des outils et technologies liés à notre activité de reconditionnement ;

- contribuer à l’amélioration de nos processus.

Vos compétences

Nous recherchons un étudiant ou une étudiante en formation technique ou ingénierie.

Profil recherché :

- curiosité et volonté d’apprendre ;

- intérêt pour le travail manuel et l’atelier ;

- sérieux dans l’exécution des tâches ;

- capacité à suivre des consignes ;

- envie de découvrir le monde de la technologie des batteries.

Une première expérience en atelier, en mécanique, en électricité ou en électronique est un plus, mais n’est pas obligatoire.

Avantages

- Une expérience formatrice dans une petite entreprise innovante ;

- une immersion dans le monde de la technologie des batteries ;

- une découverte concrète de l’assemblage de batteries pour vélos électriques ;

- un cadre de travail convivial ;

- une participation directe aux activités de production de l’entreprise.

Candidature : merci d’envoyer votre CV.

Un entretien en visio sera organisé pour les candidatures retenu

title: Offre de Stage : Assistant(e) Communication
description:
Inspicast Studio est un studio de production audio et vidéo en plein développement, basé à Garges-lès-Gonesse (95). Notre mission ? Produire des contenus professionnels de qualité pour faire rayonner les projets de nos clients. Nous offrons un environnement de production premium (captation vidéo 4K, matériel haut de gamme Shure/Rode) dans deux univers immersifs : un plateau type TV/Radio ("Deskcast") et un espace lounge ("Cosycast"). Nous accompagnons aussi bien les créateurs de contenus (YouTube, Reels, TikTok) que les entreprises grâce à notre service B2B dédié à la communication interne (podcasts filmés, onboarding, interviews d'experts).

Pour accompagner notre croissance et booster notre visibilité, nous recherchons notre futur(e) stagiaire en communication !

Vos missions

Directement rattaché(e) à l'équipe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans notre stratégie de développement, tant sur le marché B2B (entreprises, marques) que B2C (particuliers, créateurs). Vos missions s'articuleront autour des axes suivants :

  • 📱 Communication & Social Media : Animation de nos réseaux sociaux, création de posts engageants et élaboration d'un calendrier éditorial pour mettre en valeur le savoir-faire d'Inspcast Studio.
  • 📈 Prospection & Croissance : Participation active à notre stratégie d'acquisition via des campagnes de prospection par e-mail ciblées (B2B/B2C) pour attirer de nouveaux clients.
  • 🎬 Terrain & Production de contenu : Vous ne resterez pas derrière votre bureau ! Vous accompagnerez nos opérateurs sur place lors des sessions pour les aider dans la mise en place technique et capturer des contenus "coulisses" (making-of, stories) destinés à notre propre promotion.
  • 💻 CRM, site internet & reporting : Prise en main et optimisation du CRM, mise en place de stratégies digitales, création et gestion de newslette

title: Ressources humaines
description:
Rejoignez Hogan Lovells, un des cabinets d’avocats les plus prestigieux au monde !

Hogan Lovells est l’un des 10 premiers cabinets d’avocats au monde. Il regroupe plus de 2800 avocats répartis dans plus de 35 bureaux en Europe, aux États-Unis, en Amérique Latine, au Moyen-Orient et en Asie, qui assistant les entreprises, institutions financières et organismes d’État pour l’ensemble des questions juridiques auxquelles ils sont confrontés au niveau local et mondial.

Le bureau parisien de Hogan Lovells compte plus de 190 avocats, dont 44 associés, qui travaillent étroitement avec leurs homologues des autres bureaux de notre réseau international.

Vos missions

Vos futures missions au sein d’une équipe RH solaire et bienveillante

Administration du personnel

  • Familiarisation avec la gestion administrative des salariés.
  • Gérer le parcours des stagiaires et alternants : onboarding, suivi RH, conformité des dossiers, accompagnement.
  • Participer aux processus RH clés : embauches, sorties sur Workday, rédaction des contrats, avenants et conventions.
  • Contribuer au reporting RH (BDESE, tableaux RH…).
  • Assurer une veille sociale

Développement RH

  • Participer activement au recrutement des stagiaires avocats et éventuellement des fonctions support : rédaction d’annonces, tri de CV, pré-sélections, participation aux entretiens.
  • Aider à l’organisation des événements RH internes/externes (forums écoles, animations, ateliers…).
  • Conduire les entretiens de fin de stage et analyser les retours sur Excel.
  • Intervenir sur des missions transverses.

Vos compétences

🎓 Profil recherché

  • Étudiant.e en Master Ressources Humaines, école de commerce, université ou équivalent.
  • Un premier stage de 6 mois en recrutement ou en RH serait un plu

title: Alternant Conseiller Client H/F
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

RENTSCAPE est une marque en forte croissance, spécialisée dans la location de véhicules. Déjà implantés dans les principaux pôles touristiques du Grand Ouest, nous poursuivons notre développement avec l’ouverture de nombreux nouveaux points de vente.

Dans ce contexte dynamique, nous recherchons un(e) alternant(e) prêt(e) à s’investir dans une entreprise en pleine expansion.

Vos missions

En tant qu’alternant(e) conseiller commercial, vous serez au cœur de l’activité de l’agence.

Rattaché(e) au responsable d’agence, vous contribuerez directement à la performance commerciale et serez un véritable ambassadeur de la marque.

  • Booster le chiffre d’affaires via la vente de services additionnels

  • Découvrir le fonctionnement global d’une agence

  • Préparer les véhicules (niveaux, contrôles, entretien courant)
  • Organiser les interventions avec les garages partenaires

Votre profil

  • Excellent relationnel et sens du service client
  • Autonome, responsable et organisé(e)
  • Dynamique, avec un vrai esprit commercial
  • Goût du challenge et esprit d’équipe<

  • Real leverage from AI-assisted development, whatever your setup
  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through
  • Full working proficiency in English; German is a plus, not a requirement

title: Customer Experience Manager
description: NESA WORLD fabrica en Donostia San Sebastián el NESA XSIGNAL®, un dispositivo médico de neuromodulación no invasiva que actúa sobre el sistema nervioso autónomo. Lo usan más de 1.500 clínicas y más de 2.000 profesionales sanitarios se han formado con nosotros.  Cuando una clínica incorpora un XSIGNAL empieza la parte más larga de la relación: la instalación, las consultas de los primeros meses, los consumibles, alguna incidencia técnica y, si el servicio es bueno, la recomendación a otro centro. Buscamos incorporar a la persona que dirija esa relación.  Diriges el área de Customer Experience: atención al cliente nacional e internacional (consultas, pedidos de consumibles, incidencias) y customer success (que cada clínica use el equipo, recompre y recomiende). Reportas a la Directora General Adjunta.  Qué harás en NESA   Organizar la atención a clínicas y distribuidores, nacional e internacional, para que nadie se quede esperando respuesta.  Llevar las incidencias técnicas con almacén y servicio técnico hasta que estén cerradas.  Hacer crecer la recompra de consumibles y recuperar a los clientes que han dejado de comprar.  Gestionar quejas y reclamaciones según el procedimiento del sistema de calidad, junto al equipo de Calidad.  Medir tiempo de respuesta, incidencias cerradas, satisfacción y recompra, y presentarlo cada semana a Dirección.   Qué buscamos   Cuatro años o más en atención al cliente, customer success o customer experience en entorno B2B/ B2C, y al menos dos dirigiendo personas.  Inglés alto. Lo vas a usar a diario con distribuidores.  Experiencia con CRM o ERP. Si es Odoo, mejor.  Valoramos portugués o francés y experiencia con producto sanitario o equipamiento técnico.  No pedimos una titulación concreta.   Qué ofrecemos   Contrato indefinido.  Salario acorde al puesto. Te damos la cifra en la primera llamada.  Oficina en Zuatzu.   La señal NESA: el paciente al final del cable. Evidencia, no promesas. Claro, de frente y a tiempo. Confiamos primero. Microcambios, grandes efectos.  Cómo aplicar    Envíanos tu candidatura a través de LinkedIn. Si quieres, añade tres líneas sobre una incidencia difícil con un cliente que hayas resuelto. Todas las candidaturas se tratan con confidencialidad.

You are accountable for moving accounts from solving individual pain points to an Enterprise AI platform of record—embedding the Celonis platform as a strategic pillar within the client’s operations.

About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

title: Product Safety & Certification Engineer - Fuel Cell Systems
description:
About EH Group Engineering

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking a Functional Safety Engineer to embed safety into our fuel cell systems, leading hazard analysis and safety engineering across hardware, software and controls to ensure our products are safe, compliant and certifiable.

This role requires full-time, on-site presence at our Nyon, Switzerland office. We're not able to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be prepared to relocate.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Own the functional safety lifecycle for fuel cell systems from concept to release

• Lead hazard and risk analyses (HARA, HAZOP, FMEA/FMEDA, FTA) and define safety goals

• Derive safety requirements and concepts and allocate them across hardware, software and controls

• Define/verify safety mechanisms, diagnostics and safe states with the controls and embedded teams

• Perform safety analyses and calculations (SIL/PL/ASIL determination, metrics, PFH/PFD)

• Compile safety cases, safety plans and supporting documentation for certification

• Interface with

UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We're hiring a VP of Financial Planning & Analysis to build and lead our FP&A function. You will build the financial model from scratch, set up the planning process, and give the CFO and executive team the numbers and recommendations they need to make decisions. Over ons

De halfgeleiderindustrie vraagt om steeds krachtigere chips: meer bandbreedte, minder energieverbruik. Onze technologie levert precies dat. Zo wordt baanbrekend onderzoek omgezet in de bouwstenen van de chips van morgen.

Black Semiconductor is op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Technicus (m/v/x) om ons team op locatie in Zoetermeer, Nederland, te versterken.

Je speelt een cruciale rol bij het waarborgen van de betrouwbare werking van alle technische systemen die onze cleanroomomgeving ondersteunen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor onderhouds-, storingsanalyse- en reparatiewerkzaamheden aan voorzieningen zoals luchtbehandeling, gas-, water- en elektrische systemen. Deze functie is ideaal voor een praktisch ingestelde professional met technisch inzicht die graag zelfstandig werkt, technische uitdagingen oplost en nieuwe vaardigheden ontwikkelt in een sterk gecontroleerde en innovatieve omgeving.

title: Senior-Consultant / Berater (d/w/m)
description:
Wer wir sind

Meliorate ist eine Managementberatung mit Standorten in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und München.
Wir beraten Unternehmen mit komplexen, asset-intensiven Geschäftsmodellen – zum Beispiel Netzbetreiber aus der Energie- oder Wasserwirtschaft – bei strategischen und organisatorischen Fragestellungen.

Dabei arbeiten wir eng mit unseren Kund:innen zusammen und verbinden fundierte Analysen mit einem klaren Fokus auf Umsetzbarkeit.

Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von klaren Erwartungen, direktem Feedback und dem Anspruch, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Deine Rolle

Du übernimmst in Projekten eigenständig Verantwortung und arbeitest an strategischen Fragestellungen unserer Kund:innen.

Im Detail bedeutet das:

  • Du analysierst strategische und organisatorische Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinem Team strukturierte und umsetzbare Lösungen

  • Du strukturierst komplexe Problemstellungen, wertest Daten aus und leitest fundierte Handlungsempfehlungen ab (z. B. Benchmarks, Abweichungsanalysen)

  • Du präsentierst Ergebnisse und arbeitest mit Stakeholder:innen auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen

  • Du übernimmst eigenständig Arbeitspakete und trägst Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung

  • Du baust Dir ein eigenes Netzwerk bei Kund:innen auf und entwickelst Deine Rolle im Projektteam weiter

  • Du bringst Dich in interne Themen ein und unterstützt den Aufbau von Wissen innerhalb des Unternehmens

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Du arbeitest in Projektteams, in denen Du Verantwortung übernimmst und Deine Themen eigenständig vorantreibst.

title: Founding GTM & Sales Manager - DACH & Nordics (gn) @ AI Digital Defense Venture, Germany
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

About the Venture

We build frontier artificial intelligence that helps governments and defence organisations make sense of a fast-moving information environment. Our systems help the teams responsible for national security read a complex information environment faster and clearer than ever before. We've closed a pre-seed round and are already running live government pilots, with plans to expand across Europe and beyond. This is an early, venture-backed company doing work that carries weight.

About the Role

This is a founding role for our expansion across the DACH region and the Nordics. You will own how we grow here, from the first conversation through to a signed contract, building the region much as we built the UK: learning the landscape, opening doors, landing pilots and turning them into long-term contracts. You will work closely with the founders and with a forward-deployed engineer who builds the tools, integrations and prototypes that a live sales process needs, so your job is to win the room, work out what the customer actually needs, and direct that build until the deal closes.

What you'll do

  • Own go-to-market across the DACH region and the Nordics, winning and growing contracts across government, defence and large enterprise, from first conversation through to close.

  • Map the region from a blank slate, find the advisory relationships that open doors, and build a network where we do not have one yet.

title: Staff Engineer (m|w|d) - CRM Tech
description:
Reliable data, resilient services and scalable architectures are at the heart of every CRM interaction at idealo. As a Staff Engineer, you'll shape the technical foundation behind identity resolution, subscriptions, data flows, and message delivery while ensuring GDPR compliance and supporting personalized user experiences.

This role combines backend engineering, data engineering and architectural leadership. You'll influence how data flows across systems, how services communicate through event-driven architectures, and how technical decisions support idealo's long-term CRM strategy. Working closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers and Product Managers, you'll help define technical direction across multiple domains.

From data ingestion and transformation to customer-facing activation, you'll help build reliable systems that teams across idealo depend on every day. The position is available in full or part-time.

  • Stay hands-on by designing and developing cloud-native microservices, event-driven applications and backend services with a strong focus on performance, security and operational excellence.

title: Senior Quality Engineer - Checkout & Payments (m/w/d)
description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Als Senior Quality Engineer – Checkout & Payments trägst du dazu bei, zuverlässige Zahlungsabläufe über Shopware, Shopware Payments und externe Systeme hinweg sicherzustellen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf praxisnahen Integrationstests, Testautomatisierung und Release-Validierung: Du prüfst, ob Kund:innen einen Kauf erfolgreich abschließen können, Bestell- und Zahlungsstatus korrekt sind und Fehler sowie Wiederholungsversuche sicher verarbeitet werden.

  • Risikobasierte Testabdeckung definieren und umsetzen. Arbeite mit Product und Engineering zusammen, um kritische Abläufe für Händler:innen und Kund:innen, die vorhandene Testabdeckung und Lücken zu identifizieren. Stimme für jedes Entwicklungspaket einen klar abgegrenzten Testumfang ab und begleite ihn durch Umsetzung, Review und Validierung.

  • Entwickle und verbessere wiederverwendbare Sicherheitskontrollen, Leitfäden für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien und praxisnahe Automatisierung zur Erkennung und Behebung von Schwachstellen.

Baue eine dauerhafte Product-Security-Engineering-Funktion für die Shopware-Produkte auf. Die Funktion verantwortet die Ergebnisse im Bereich Product Security Engineering und das Betriebsmodell für diese Arbeit. Sie ersetzt weder die Governance durch InfoSec noch die Verantwortung der Engineering-Domänen, die Freigabe durch Quality oder Product Operations.

Cosuno is a platform for construction tendering in the German-speaking market. It connects general contractors, who publish bid packages, with subcontractors, who bid on them, and both sides pay. As our GTM & Growth Engineer, you build the automation and data behind marketing and growth. You find where work is manual or where data goes unused, build a solution that works in one area, such as paid marketing, lifecycle, sales handovers or content, and then reuse it across the others. You work closely with our Senior Lifecycle & Customer Growth Manager, the Demand Generation Manager and the Marketing Lead, and you ship things with a business outcome attached, not infrastructure for its own sake. You'll be the first engineer in a lean marketing team: you'll shape how our growth stack is built, not just maintain a fixed setup.

What you'll do

  • You automate marketing and lifecycle operations: triggers, segments, workflows and personalization in ActiveCampaign and Salesforce, so journeys react to what customers do.

  • You automate paid marketing: audience syncs and suppression from CRM and product data, conversion data fed back to the ad platforms, and campaign feeds and landing pages that adapt to where bids are missing on the Marketplace. Demand Generation owns strategy and budget; you build the machinery.

  • You build the data and signal plumbing: product events, Salesforce, ActiveCampaign, enrichment, transaction history and our BigQuery warehouse, connected, clean and usable.

  • You automate creative production: ad, email and landing-page variants inside our brand templates, with human review before anything goes live.

title: Head of Data & Analytics (m/w/d)
description:
Über Scento

Scento ist Europas größte Website für Parfum-Abfüllungen. Das 2024 gegründete Unternehmen hat seinen Hauptsitz in Paris an der Place Vendôme und ein zweites Büro in Berlin. Scento bietet mehr als 1.000 originale Designer- und Nischendüfte aus einem Portfolio von 200 Parfumhäusern als Abfüllungen an: Fläschchen mit 2 ml, 5 ml und 8 ml sowie bei den meisten Düften eine 30-ml-Flasche. Mit Parfumproben von Nischen- und Designerdüften lässt sich ein Duft entdecken, bevor man sich für einen ganzen Flakon entscheidet. Jedes Parfum ist ein Original von autorisierten europäischen Händlern, und jede Flasche durchläuft vor dem Abfüllen eine 12-Punkte-Eingangsprüfung in Scentos ISO-zertifizierter Einrichtung.

Scento beliefert Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten und versendet in 26 EU-Länder. Scentos Jahresumsatz liegt 2026 bei mehr als 30 Millionen Euro, online und offline zusammen. Auf Scento.com war der monatliche Absatz von Abfüllungen im September 2026 3,2-mal so hoch wie im Januar 2026. Nach eigenen Angaben verkauft Scento mehr als 3 Millionen Parfum-Abfüllungen pro Jahr, etwa eine alle 10 Sekunden. Im November 2025 kündigte Scento an, über drei Jahre 25 Millionen Euro in die Entdeckung von Parfum in Europa zu investieren.

Deine Rolle

Scento verkauft Parfumproben und Abfüllungen an Kundinnen und Kunden in 27 europäischen Märkten, und fast jede Entscheidung hängt an Zahlen: Wie viel Marketingbudget lohnt sich, welche Düfte gehen aus, welche Kohorten kommen wieder. title: Business Development Intern (GTM) (m/f/d)
description:
About Ordio

80% of the world’s workforce doesn’t sit at a desk, yet most software is built for the 20% who do. Ordio is the AI-native workforce management (WFM) system for deskless workforces: shift planning, time tracking and payroll for the people who keep restaurants, shops and services running.

The role

This is not a “support the team and update spreadsheets” internship. You’ll help find out where Ordio’s next stage of growth comes from, and then make it happen. You get real problems and the tools to solve them, and nobody tells you how.

What you will do

  • Find new growth levers and revenue streams. Spot opportunities and take them from 0 to 1 and beyond: analyze, test, iterate, scale

  • Understand the problem first. Talk to customers, map markets and figure out what deskless businesses actually struggle with

  • Get to product-market fit in new verticals. Find out which industries need Ordio most, validate quickly and build the go-to-market for them

  • Drive geographical expansion. Evaluate new markets, size the opportunity and build the playbook for entering them

  • Build AI-powered GTM engines. Automate research, enrichment and outbound with Clay, HubSpot, LLMs and whatever else works

  • Work directly with the founders on strategy, and own at least one initiative end-to-end

Who you are

  • High agency: you don’t wait for instructions, you figure it out and ship

  • Obsessed with understanding problems, customers and markets before jumping to solutions

  • You already use AI tools beyond ChatGPT prompts, e.g. agents and automations

  • Analytical and numbers-driven, comfortable making decisions with incomplete data

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Student (Bachelor/Master)

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

title: Major Gifts Officer
description:
Mozilla Foundation is a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.

We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. We build side by side with developers, innovators and advocates, united in the belief that a better technology future is not only possible — it’s ours to create!

Team

Major Gifts are becoming a load-bearing part of how Mozilla Foundation funds its mission — and that revenue doesn't materialize on its own. Someone has to build real relationships with donors capable of giving at the $50,000 to $1M+ level, and turn those relationships into closed gifts rather than a portfolio that's always “warming up.”

That's this role. As Major Gifts Officer, you'll sit within Mozilla Foundation's Development team and work closely with the VP of Development, program staff, and Mozilla's executive leadership to identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward a portfolio of major donors. You'll be the person personally accountable for moving a donor from interest to a signed commitment — translating Mozilla's work on digital rights, internet health, and technology policy into the kind of tailored, compelling case that moves people to give, and to keep giving.

Job responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the first 6 months:

  • Get up to speed on Mozilla's existing major gift portfolio and pipeline in Salesforce, and start building relationships with current donors.
  • Move existing prospects who are already in active cultivation toward a solicitation.
  • Partner with prospect research to identify and begin qualifying new major gift prospects for your portfolio.
  • Help plan and deliver a stewardship touchpoint or donor event that deepens an existing major donor relationship.
  • Start shaping a tailored proposal or impact story, drawing on input from program and executive staff, for one of your priority donors.

As a Major Gifts Officer at Mozilla Foundation, you will…

  • Personally solicit and close five-, six-, and seven-figure gifts from donors capable of giving at the $50,000–$1M+ level.
  • Move donors from interest to a signed commitment on a timeline that actually progresses, rather than leaving a portfolio perpetually “warming up.”
  • Help the major gifts program consistently hit its revenue targets.
  • Manage a portfolio of major donor relationships, systematically advancing prospects through cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.
  • Keep every meaningful donor interaction documented in Salesforce, so relationship history is accurate and the next move is always clear.

title: Principal, User Research
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

At Mural, we believe great collaboration starts with deep understanding. Our mission is to help teams think and work together better. The Design and Research team uncovers the truths that power that mission, guiding product, design, and strategy through rigorous, human-centered inquiry. We combine behavioral science, market insight, and creative exploration to shape Mural’s future for how teams ideate, align, and collaborate together across the world.

YOUR MISSION

As the Principal, User Researcher at Mural, you’ll start a UX research practice and lead foundational and strategic research that shapes how the company defines its next generation of experiences. You’ll partner across product, design, sales, marketing, and strategy to identify new opportunity spaces, clarify evolving user needs, and guide the organization toward long-term innovation.

This is a primarily individual-contributor role focused on uncovering deep human collaboration insights that drive strategy, innovation, and long-term vision. You’ll also help shape and scale the UXR discipline at Mural by mentoring designers to confidently run tactical usability studies, and establishing the frameworks and best practices that elevate research across the company. Think of it as being the first research leader at a fast-growing startup, with the reach and resources of a global platform.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Player Responsibilities (Individual Contributor Work):

  • Lead mixed-methods research (qualitative and quantitative) that explores user needs, behaviors, and motivations across multiple product areas.

  • Drive foundational studies that reveal how teams collaborate and what barriers exist in business collaboration, hybrid, and distributed work.

  • Design and execute medium to large-scale studies that combine qualitative depth with quantitative rigor (surveys, logs analysis, segmentation, and concept testing).

  • Develop a tempo where actionable insights are timely and urgently positioned to shape key product decisions.

  • Translate ambiguous questions into clear learning plans and frameworks that guide product and strategy decisions.

  • Build artifacts (archetypes, frameworks, journey maps, mental models) that make complex insights accessible and actionable across the company, leveraging Mural products.

  • Present insights to an executive, cross-functional audience and provide strategic recommendations based on these insights.

Coach Responsibilities:

  • Build the research practice: mentor designers, and product partners in research best practices, helping to scale a culture of curiosity and evidence-based decision making.

  • Establish repeatable, high-quality research

title: Engineering Manager - EU
description:
Hi I’m Colin, Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby.

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

  • Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

  • Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little interventi

Staff Software Engineer, AI-Native Systems (Tech Lead)

Location: Remote (US)

We are

Virtual care only works if the infrastructure behind it does. Wheel builds that infrastructure — the systems that let telehealth run at scale for the patients, clinicians, and companies depending on it. We're not bolting AI onto old workflows; we're rebuilding them from the ground up. Our mission to put great healthcare in everyone's reach means replacing manual, ad-hoc processes with intelligent, agent-powered systems that carry real operational load. We're innovating in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now.

You are

A staff-level engineer who sets technical direction for agentic systems and then leads the work to ship them. Hi! I'm Chris, head of Product Design at Ashby.

We're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. At Ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). We do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on.

Our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, very low churn, and many years of runway. We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet.

How We Work

In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers.

We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager.

This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. We don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean.

Currently, I report to Benji, the co-founder & CEO. Both Abhik and Benji (our founders) care deeply about design, which at first glance may seem counterintuitive given the number of full-time designers that we employ. title: Senior Software Engineer C++/C# für verteilte Systeme (m/w/x)
description:
Projektbeschreibung:

Begeistern Sie sich für Technik? Wir auch! Zur Verstärkung unseres Expertenteams bei unserem Kunden aus der Funk- und Kommunikationsbranche suchen wir einen Senior Software Engineer C++/C# für verteilte Systeme (m/w/x) in Festanstellung bei K-tronik. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie persönlich kennenzulernen – und gemeinsam mit Leidenschaft und Teamgeist an spannenden Projekten und zukunftsweisenden Technologien zu arbeiten.


Aufgaben:

  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und optimierst Softwaremodule in C++ und C# innerhalb einer verteilten Systemlandschaft auf Windows- und Linux-Systemen.
  • Du implementierst leistungsfähige Kommunikationsschnittstellen, beispielsweise auf Basis von gRPC, und nutzt dabei moderne asynchrone Programmiermodelle.
  • Du entwickelst stabile und performante Anwendungen unter Einsatz von Multithreading und Concurrency-Konzepten.
  • Du stellst durch den gezielten Einsatz von Design Patterns eine hohe Wartbarkeit, Qualität und Erweiterbarkeit des Codes sicher.
  • Du bindest relationale Datenbanken an, optimierst Datenstrukturen und entwickelst automatisierte Unit- und Integrationstests.
  • Du arbeitest aktiv in einem agilen Scrum-Team mit, führst Code Reviews durch und unterstützt bei der technischen Ausarbeitung und Schätzung von User Stories.

Qualifikationen:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung oder Ausbildung
  • Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit C++ und C#.
  • Du kennst Dich mit verteilten Systemen, asynchroner Programmierung sowie Multithreading und Concurrency aus.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit gRPC (oder vergleichbaren Technologien), relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise PostgreSQL, sowie Design Patterns.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Git/GitLab, Jira und bringst Erfahrung in agilen Entwicklungsumgebungen

title: TYPO3-Senior-Entwickler/in (m/w/d)
description:
Die websedit AG ist eine Full-Service Internetagentur mit Sitz in Ravensburg in der Bodensee Region. Wir gestalten und entwickeln anspruchsvolle Web-Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Für unser Team suchen wir Kolleginnen und Kollegen in der TYPO3-Entwicklung.

Deine Rolle

Wir entwickeln anspruchsvolle, skalierbare Websites und digitale Plattformen auf Basis von TYPO3. Dabei verbinden wir ein strukturiertes Figma-Designsystem mit modernen, KI-gestützten Entwicklungsprozessen.

Als Senior-TYPO3-Entwickler (m/w/d) übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für unsere TYPO3-Architektur, entwickelst individuelle Extensions und stellst die Qualität unserer Implementierungen sicher. Gemeinsam mit Design und Entwicklung gestaltest du einen Workflow, in dem Figma und moderne Entwicklungswerkzeuge sinnvoll zusammenspielen.

KI betrachten wir dabei als Entwicklungswerkzeug: Wiederkehrende Aufgaben können automatisiert werden, während Architekturentscheidungen, fachliche Modellierung, Qualitätssicherung und technische Verantwortung bei erfahrenen Entwicklern bleiben.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige professionelle TYPO3-Erfahrung und sehr gute Kenntnisse in den im Unternehmen eingesetzten TYPO3-Versionen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in PHP, objektorientierter Entwicklung, Fluid, TypoScript und Extbase

  • Erfahrung mit individuellen Extensions, sauberer Softwarearchitektur und wiederverwendbaren Komponenten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Composer, Git und modernen Deployment-Prozessen

  • Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung, Mehrsprachigkeit und redaktionellen Workflows

  • Kenntnisse in automatisierten Tests, Websicherheit und Performanceoptimierung

  • Eine eigenverantwortliche, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Entscheidungen verständlich zu vermitteln und zu dokumentieren

title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) Technische Gebäudeausrüstung
description:
Du hast Lust auf Verantwortung, Zusammenarbeit mit einem starken Team und spannende Baustellen? Dann suchen wir genau Dich:

Projektleiter (m/w/d) Technische Gebäudeausrüstung

Aufgaben

DEINE MISSION: TGA IM GRIFF

  • Gemeinsam zum Projekterfolg: Du verantwortest die Gewerke der technischen Gebäudeausrüstung, während der Projektleiter Schlüsselfertigbau die Gesamtverantwortung für das Bauvorhaben trägt. Gemeinsam mit der Bauleitung bildet Ihr ein starkes Projektteam und sorgt für eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung unserer Bauprojekte. Darüber hinaus unterstützt Du den Kalkulator mit Deiner technischen Expertise.

  • TGA-Projektsteuerung: Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort auf der Baustelle und steuerst von dort die TGA-Gewerke eigenverantwortlich über alle Projektphasen hinweg. Dabei stellst Du die Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Termin- und Kostenzielen sicher. Zudem begleitest Du gemeinsam mit unserem Einkauf die Vergabe von Nachunternehmerleistungen.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Als zentraler Ansprechpartner für TGA-relevante Themen sorgst Du für einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss und abgestimmte Prozesse zwischen Bauherrn, Fachplanern, Nachunternehmern und dem Projektteam.

  • Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung: Du dokumentierst Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungen und relevante Vorgänge transparent und nachvollziehbar.

Qualifikation

DEIN PROFIL: BAULEIDENSCHAFT TRIFFT TECHNISCHES KNOWHOW

  • Qualifikation: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Versorgungstechnik, Technische Gebäudeausrüstung (TGA), MSR-, Energie- oder Gebäudetechnik. Alternativ verfügst Du über eine Qualifikation als Techniker oder Meister in einem dieser Fachbereiche.

title: Senior Account Manager DACH
description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Graphene Photonics Data Analyst (f/m/d)
description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

 

The Role

As a Graphene Photonics Data Analyst, you will transform complex characterization data into reliable insights that guide device design, process development, and manufacturing decisions. You will own and evolve our analysis software, develop new methods for emerging experiments, and help scale our analytical capabilities as we transition from R&D to high-volume production.

Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto is building the intelligence layer between bits and atoms, connecting the digital world of engineering with the physical world of manufacturing. It’s how AI gets into the real economy.

More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto. We’re the category leader in DACH, backed by Sequoia and Index, and we’re just getting started.

What you'll do

Find the problems worth solving, then solve them end to end. Talk to customers, build across the whole stack, and ship to production. What we mean by Builder

Because of AI, we only hire Builders. No specialized roles.

A Builder takes a messy, unclear problem and owns it from start to finish. That goes for business problems, not just customer problems. You decide what’s worth doing, make the case for it, test the risky parts early, and see it through until it pays off. When something works, you share it so everyone gets better.

We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.”

How we build - The Tacto Engineer

Builder is the what. The Tacto Engineer is the how. It’s our engineering practice and the bar we hold each other

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

title: Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais  (H/F)

À propos de notre client

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais.  Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

  • Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
  • Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
  • Consult

En tant que data scientist, vous rejoindrez l'équipe Pulsar aux côtés de trois autres data scientists.

Veepee développe des algorithmes de pointe en matière de prévision et de tarification, qui constituent des priorités stratégiques pour l’entreprise.

title: Head of Finance (w/d/m)
description:
Über LIFTED

LIFTED is a strength training company from Berlin. We run six studios across the city and plan to have 20 by the end of 2027, with Munich, Hamburg, Cologne and Düsseldorf next. Our goal is to become the largest fitness company in Europe. Before LIFTED, the founding team helped build and scale BEAT81. Today we’re profitable and owner-led.

Why this role exists
Today Carl, one of the founders, runs finance alongside managing the company, with bookkeeping at an external tax firm. You take this over and build the finance team.


Your role
You report to Carl, sit in the management meeting and approve spending within budget.


What you own

  • Finance ops. You lead our finance trainee, who handles receipts, invoices and account coding based on clear rules. You review samples, resolve new cases and adapt the rules. You also manage payments, payroll and the month-end and year-end close with our tax firm.

  • Planning and liquidity. You own our planning model, plan liquidity monthly, and run the annual and three-year budget, forecasts and scenarios. Before we sign a new location, you build its business case and add it to the planning model.

  • Reporting. You set up monthly management reporting that we use in the management meeting.

  • Financing. You prepare our financing and, over time, lead parts of the conversations with our financing partners.

  • HR admin. You handle employee data and contracts. Right now that’s a few hours a month.

  • Team. You build the finance team and help us decide when HR needs its own role.

How we measure success

  • After 3 months, you’ve taken over finance from Carl, from daily operations and HR admin to planning and liquidity.</

title: Total Rewards & People Business Partner
description:
People Business Partner & Total Rewards

Most People roles ask you to run processes someone else built. This one asks you to build them, and to own one of them outright: how Eye rewards and recognises its people. You’ll do that while partnering the part of the business where cybersecurity actually happens, with managers who are still learning to lead and specialists who know exactly how rare they are. If you need a mature organization around you to do your best work, this isn’t it. If you get energy from building one, keep reading.

The role

This role has two halves, and you’ll split your time roughly evenly between them.

The first half is Total Rewards. You’ll own compensation and benefits at Eye, including salary reviews, benchmarking, levelling, benefits and our equity program. There’s no finished framework waiting for you. You’ll shape it, make it hold up as we grow, and get us ready for EU pay transparency. You don’t need to be a reward specialist yet. If you owned reward projects before and want to make this your expertise, this is where you do it.

The second half is partnering. You’ll be the People Business Partner for our core business: security operations, incident response, customer support & onboarding, and project management. It’s the most varied population in the company: working students running shift rosters next to deeply specialized senior engineers, and managers at very different stages of their leadership journey.

That mix is exactly why this role needs presence more than years. You’ll coach a first-time manager on the basics one hour and align a salary band with C-level the next. You’ll need to be comfortable doing both, and to enjoy it.

What you’ll do

title: Working Student Talent Acquisition
description:
